We’ve been talking a lot on the campaign trail about how every one of us has a role to play in our fight to save democracy. There is no one person or one law that is going to thwart the dangerous attacks from those who seek to undermine our elections. [**That's why I'm so excited about this panel discussion, and I hope you’ll join our speical livestreamed event with us next week. clean_body: | | | Hey, Peter — This Thursday, you’re invited to our first national WFP Welcome Gathering of 2024! Whether you’re brand new to the party or have been with us for a while and want to get more involved, Welcome Gatherings are your space to meet other WFP members and activists, and learn how together we can build the country and the party of our dreams. At the Working Families Party, we fight to elect candidates who will put the people before the powerful. But our work goes beyond campaigns. Together, we’re building a party and a political home for everyone who wants to see this country work for the many — not the few. We’re growing our grassroots movement year by year and building power to make a real difference for our friends, family, and loved ones. Our monthly Welcome Gatherings are an opportunity to spend time in joyful community with other WFP members across the country. And this month, we’ll also be hearing from Working Families Party organizers about some of our critical organizing in Arizona, and getting concrete about our party’s strategy to change this country for the better. Whether you can make it or not, thank you for all you do as a WFP member, Peter. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. [**Former Florida lawmaker, U.S. Congressional candidate, endorses James Judge for Congress**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=7a8ad58212&e=00028e5542)
_A former member of the Florida House of Representatives who is the GOP chairman for Lake County and is currently running for U.S. Congress endorsed James Judge in his bid to unseat incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL)._
DADE CITY, Fla. – Anthony Sabatini, a Republican former state legislator in Florida, endorsed James Judge Monday in Judge’s primary bid to unseat Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL) in Florida’s 12th Congressional District.
Sabatini served as a State Representative in Florida’s 32nd District from 2018 to 2022, and he is currently running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Florida’s 11th Congressional District in a primary race against incumbent Daniel Webster (R-FL).
Sabatini is an attorney, Army Veteran, Florida National Guardsman and chairman of the Lake County Republican Party.
“Congressional candidates who want to truly address the issues that matter to Floridians, and frankly all Americans, need to band together and support each other,” said Sabatini. “That’s why I’m proud to endorse James Judge in his race against Gus Bilirakis. Just like my opponent, Gus is the very embodiment of the term ‘career politician.’ It’s time for these uniparty politicians to be retired and for younger patriots to step up and repair the damage they have allowed to happen.”
Sabatini cited Judge’s positions on the economy and immigration as the primary reasons for his endorsement.
“James and I not only share in a fraternal brotherhood as veterans, but we share the same positions on the state of our economy and the urgent need to secure our wide-open border,” said Sabatini. “The current Republican Congress isn’t getting the job done. They’re sending money we don’t have oversees and burying the next generations in debt. They haven’t meaningfully opposed Joe Biden’s open border in any way. If they can’t, or won’t take action to solve these pressing problems, it is time for them to step aside and make way for people who will, like James and I.”
**About James Judge:** James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Dade City, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

subject: this phone call changed my life forever
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
sharing my dad's story with you
| | |
---
Friend, when I was young, I thought I would follow in my dad's footsteps and become an entrepreneur.
I worked hard to win scholarships so I could put myself through college. Once I got there, I studied hard and discovered that I had my dad's knack for it, so I thought I might end up working internationally to assist developing nations.
**But then, when I was 24, working on my Master's degree,_everything changed._**
I was in class, just like any other day, when someone came into the classroom. There was a call for me. It was urgent. My heart dropped. I knew immediately that something was very, very wrong. I answered the phone and heard my sister's voice on the other line.
**My dad had been shot outside of his home in Ecuador. He didn't make it.** I had just talked to him the night before, and now, he was gone forever. In an instant, my entire world shattered.
I packed a bag and left for Ecuador with my sisters that night. It took me a long, long time to move past the initial shock and despair. **When I finally was able to start putting the pieces of my life back together, I knew that it would never be the same. **
I was angry at the corrupt system that failed to protect my dad and failed to give us justice. I knew that so many other families were being denied safety and justice every single day. That's why I decided to dedicate my life to giving back to my community here in Florida, fighting for justice, and protecting families.
**That path led me to nonprofits across Florida, Congress, and Giffords, where I've helped my friend Gabby Giffords fight for gun safety reforms here in Florida. Now, I'm running for Senate to continue my fight for gun violence prevention, for justice, and for safety for all families. I will never give up this work, but I need to know if you'll have my back. Please, will you respond before midnight tonight to tell me where you stand?**

Corporate special interests and greedy billionaires are trying to buy this race and keep Katie Porter out of Congress for good, because they know she’ll hold them accountable in the Senate.

name: Andrew Hughes
subject: Should Dr. Ben Carson Be Canceled?
body:
Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeoq6pasfobke8hoknat1gos6s4iurvn3qbc5j58_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cji64o36c1h2bs)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z13fin18m4gbrncr44kk51h5fjf1uf9fak2ldcng_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cji64o36c1h2bs)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country - who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you're just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture - knowing that he's broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... "Enough is enough! I'm fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what's best for the country."

If that's a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI's **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here's the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3tv0jsno0rj1l279uva6uotiflknrpljbhno5u8_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cji64o36c1h2bs)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you'll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

name: Mike Gallagher
subject: The end of an honorable deployment
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Gallagher for Wisconsin
body:
As I look back on my time in office, I am so proud of all we’ve accomplished together.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
Peter, When I first ran for Congress eight years ago, I promised to treat my time in office as a high-intensity deployment. Eight years is a long deployment, Peter. Through my bipartisan work on the Armed Services and Intelligence Committees, chairing the Cyberspace Solarium Commission, and chairing the Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, we've accomplished more than I could have ever imagined. Our Framers intended citizens to serve in Congress for a season and then return to their private lives. So, with a heavy heart, I have decided not to run for re-election. Politics was never meant to be a career, and trust me, Congress is no place to grow old. I want to thank the good people of Northeast Wisconsin for the honor of a lifetime. Serving you over the last four terms has strengthened my conviction that America is the greatest country in the history of the world, and although my title may change, my mission will always remain the same: to deter America's enemies and defend the Constitution. Thank you again for this incredible opportunity, Peter. I couldn't have done it without you by my side.
---

---
Mike Gallagher
Congressman, WI-08

subject: Dangerous legislation
body:
Peter, It's happening again. Our state government is pushing legislation that's not just wrong; it's dangerous. Bill S-2421
|
---
| Peter, It's happening again. Our state government is pushing legislation that's not just wrong; it's dangerous. Bill S-2421, dubbed the "Freedom to Read Act" and sponsored by Senators Andrew Zwicker and Teresa Ruiz, is on the verge of turning our school libraries into zones where anything goes, no matter how inappropriate.
**This legislation is a direct assault on common sense, amending existing laws to shield librarians and school media specialists from any backlash for providing access to obscene content to our kids.** Yes, you heard that right. Under the guise of a "human right to read," **this bill is pushing to normalize the exposure of our children to sexually explicit materials—without any accountability.** This isn't just a bad idea; it's a dangerous precedent. And the claim that librarians should have the unfettered right to expose our kids to such materials, no questions asked, flies in the face of every principle of responsible education and parenting. **We cannot stand idly by while this happens. Please make your voice heard before tomorrow, February 15th._This is our chance to stand up for our children's innocence and future._**
## **Tell Senator Andrew Zwicker what you think of his bill by calling his office today at (908) 308-8672.**
**New Jersey, it's time to rally. If you're as outraged by this as I am, take a stand. Together, we can protect our kids and send a clear message that there are lines we will not allow to be crossed.** Let's turn our concern into action. For our kids' sake, Bill Spadea

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

## House Impeaches Mayorkas
The House [voted to impeach ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOozAQQL8GOkeeYWygoLgmXa69Eg32OPjWYGScRPn7Vbbe8uk1T-_fbb5xTHG__-VNphryzK7Gp8yogBTSTK2fgghK18oEve5HhK6jdp0MWLSGAHw_MhuicRn6ZfRDN4oDsW2cUCNpBAJtLJqLHdFZzex4DGYg05AWH2sul_857nWVkN75KeXi8tamaa31OJvuT4PXBq987PI6P-oDpUaXpMHrmh-nqI3fuXzxqeJ2CLt1k72qZ66illy8FHWKe5RY32rQbvFmWZYhGEBnB6AAxoQBDQMCtWXyxyumFE_bN6TvG8f0E1R_3fMdAAD__1LcZYs)Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas Tuesday evening on their second try in a week, making Mayorkas the first Cabinet official to be impeached in nearly 150 years. The final vote was 214-213, with the one-vote difference [provided by GOP Rep. Steve Scalise](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPnDAQRn-N6WZlZm04CopcQXdpUqREgxmWSYxt2WbR_vtoU1_1fdJrnt7vr_mLxEt4_KSDx7rFmVyVJ88IrQE0s2nWcWNGvjc8tr3uB2zvd9Pso11bsg67pes_emMH7Yi1NT1uTg-r0Y2MqNFobE2rbYf21g3oOk3kaNjsh7HKaF6lxnz7EyXUnTf_ik_ONxePxo97ramo-w-Fk8Lpuq7bUcKbKZw4wFkUToGv96TopYp73z2ehSFzOhcvjkKBlDlRZqgRnrEy0IMkQAxw0Cvmv1RAjsTk9oNDhSX6UjnzCssLMtczB4gbFEdeCiucKMPnZyt8_UpNHtd0ifdSul4Z_ThI_H_7-m3LfwEAAP__A6B4tA), just returned from cancer treatments in the hospital. The first impeachment vote last week essentially tied while Scalise was absent. Three Republicans joined the Democrats against impeachment in the otherwise straight party-line vote. The two articles of impeachment stem from what the GOP says is Mayorkas' failure to secure the border. Mayorkas will now be tried in the Senate, where he's expected to be found not guilty by the Democratic-controlled chamber.
## Dow Falls 524 Points on Inflation News
The Dow Jones index [fell 524 points Tuesday,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAURp8GNizu5cfxwNDFW7p2tAhcxzQ4RPZtrLx9lc5dvuWTztH5Ok_nWGq5Xz_jSoHnNsXE5UkTKrAK7WRlDjMRkpEUoNf9gGCMlUsAHIz2A8EMp4u5wAms7zOBRszojJMloEarESxo59F1fsDkdYwpDrM7WSesply4bd13K3deaK6v9qStS22VNSzMj12YD4GjwPE4ji7dL-l9ChzfaIGjRoEjvGfnlm5qjduNWHHL8aVqeZL6eeTItHcLr1VuIT-OUmvZfS-svq6x1D8b_9v-GwAA___a-Vgz) erasing nearly half its gains this year in its worst plunge in 11 months. The selloff was triggered by a higher-than-expected inflation report. The Labor Department Tuesday morning announced that prices climbed 0.3% last month, or [up 3.1% from this time last year](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj72O8yAQAJ8GOluw4B8Kiq9xl6-90sKwJBthsGwSn9_-lKuvH2lmvm7zzVGifP_vVrQ1ltn5Sm-coZG6AT1rHmxEBFQcrRzEYEAqpfnDKjPIiLAMXvklBrkoMRotnAkh6lGMnCwI0AKklqLroWt7A74XznlnYjfqjmmBgWrZ22ehXB8Y01XeuLe-rDzZR63bwdQ_BhOD6TzPNpbv5XVQxuP4MAwm9CWX9WIw-Y0ayjG5SiU3T5dfbr-aTwHfbdhOSomOfmBa3FdH6ddR_zz-CQAA__9HQlf8). That was higher than expected and enough to push investors to question whether the Fed might delay interest rate cuts. The S&P 500 was hit with heavy selling too, with nearly 90% of stocks there affected [as the index dropped 1.4%.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQheGngY7IHg8GFy5uky633RJNxkOYjcERWIny9qtsveXRVxzp_7pMF9Ks2-0_rRLrXCbiqk-ZoLPYAU7YpjiLgLhWoh3MEMA6h-0Sr6EHIhAvCfHqkBGG0TkETonxKq1GMIAGLFrTe-hPPgB7Q8QU5n7EvkEjSWvZT99Ft7rInN_lKfuJy9rmuNT6OBr3r4FzA2d6bPI6PvQZe1XO0sD5qIXv3Ur7XWq3lKyJ3p1uc6aqZesCOzuKD9yLBQB0KeCAPHjzkXls95geL81ZDz80aG4raf79r3_W-AkAAP__5DxfHA)

body:
Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country

|
---
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=57ae3081445c4d6487a134361e0c137c&_e=JKdCHTORaalHn6Hoxgl07UYtVnSbkFFqvn3RGDJLCYoYCcIISPabjTgv6oT7Azp3JoCBHL0qcI9qvRnXjxkSCJmSJniqWhdmSXg7P3F000H3_pOb-NuYbqT9nR_vdHCfVZdcOXdJLMWa5cl09L5iKQkXpjnJJyVU_VB5J2PUBtEQT3kGbJCH6JvZEj6my-2W7WPAqoy1EYev-fg6rxrxtC2vKIumRNjYtcgFNPJEAKA-tfKShEySlK7yzDlx9YBhpPfL57WTJeL4_44hc-pwKRugfyGmJ6-UkBkiFrXiwiAfQh8Cf37MghakzJXjp2SXr_WRNsnoIREf-CdbuxYgU6RK9qIPQLFxvUjs4UWG4kVip-bc0fjdNrsXd2eHDeQMUGJGgND8S3rqWafUm31lKn4A9M83rI_VmJ82on6sbhE%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

Someone who continually disrespects the sacrifices of military families has no business being commander in chief.

| |

Friend,

Donald Trump had a rally in South Carolina over the weekend.

And in that rally, he mocked my husband’s military service.

**Friend, my husband, Michael, is deployed serving our country.**

I’m proud of Michael’s service. Every military spouse knows it’s a family sacrifice.

If you mock the service of a combat veteran you don’t deserve a driver’s license, let alone to be the President of the United States.

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c684784%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eWb9R%2bUgTk0Q4cQU%2beZNAw&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

subject: Are you fed up with cancel culture?
body:
Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country

|
---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f8ab876fcac405d8df6fc80a48165b6&_e=HvnpXZyme7DTcyQ1XF7qSyesr8MhWmXb-4ZfFL-cW1xCOFsNY3XgBHeLTExBbVOqwGkylmnkgcIjzqg1dtmTxfKjorQwe1uLHXZ7mwfgFOI5aOgmBG4HgGBUjWIV-ZtXevKWq_hg6pelrDrLVIXudlniTT1b9S0qrI7EwYkRmdXFm6l6lbF4nMhG4rOe3s3qy5gWTjOcAT0DTJuKQtjZ_hmMViOSJihXh-PJcqYv8JWh_ZTBU2HyhFOVaA6x7ZcfMHtDy2N7mkHJdirrfm4_Q57PeOlWu7BJ3-mnAlfkaCeGQ8YMQMHxqEfcYBsSgj3HvXZIGU0_7kYB9FQeaetC8LNVbWdiqssW3MCg-dBew834hJFo1rdc_nER5RR5VaDPruIVflq1r9uTWi2tr9Nsurg6wx00JunbVFRuhUn03qE%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what's best for our country, to help him take a stand against "cancel culture." It's tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders - who should be acting as role models for our kids - instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by "canceling" Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It's really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this - not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

"Cancel culture" tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn't listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents - hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_" What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?"_

And that's exactly what we're doing. It's why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place - to lead the way for what's best for our country.

And we've created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that's not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

body:
Thanks to Democrat Jon Tester, illegal immigrants are being given access to VA health care services before Veterans

Friend-

In 2021, the Senate Veterans Affairs Committee approved more than **[$70 million in federal funds to pay for health care costs incurred by illegal migrants.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mAGymnSt0kf7mQtoa3aHKQ&sysid=1)** More recently, the Committee approved more than $90 million to care for migrants crossing our border illegally.

Democrats charged the Department of Veterans Affairs with administering health care services to **[illegal migrants](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39212%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2w0RIsx89QORHilN19iJlg&sysid=1)** due to the sophisticated network of hospitals and clinics that were built to serve our veteran communities in all 50 states.

**[My opponent, Democrat Jon Tester, is the Committee’s chairman.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39213%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nzgiIAchGkCW59TisMS4Xw&sysid=1)**

_Every time an illegal migrant is cared for at one of our nation’s VA facilities, our veterans pay the price.

Help me defeat him. Chip in anything you can to help me defeat this Democrat and get veterans the health care they need. It’s time to stop prioritizing illegal migrants over American service members._
******************************************************[STOP THE THEFT>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39214%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=prxAFWvQWETNOyxOfq0F6A&sysid=1)******************************************************
******************************************************[JOIN ME>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39225%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mRbbJobS2vbRaWGYMxKY%2fA&sysid=1)******************************************************
**[This](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39226%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3rR%2blWXuYx3mIPhjuZzCrw&sysid=1)** Democrat-funded program has created a backlog of veteran claims surpassing 378,000. Thanks to my opponent and Joe Biden, it’s reasonable for a veteran on the backlog list to expect **[they may never get the care](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39227%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XigVs3yDhOA4Y%2bAl4GOCOw&sysid=1)** they need due to the president of the United States and Senate Democrats prioritizing illegals over veterans.

**[_Friend, don’t you think it’s a double standard that President Biden and Democrat Jon Tester are eligible to see the best doctors in the world at Walter Reed Medical Center just outside of DC - WITH NO WAIT TIME - while illegal migrants are given priority over veterans at VA facilities?_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39228%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ndbhhBXYikrpMKDY1Ndhaw&sysid=1)**

_**[Sign my petition](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39229%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WAtgma%2bUkt2aZ5ZSiBk8Wg&sysid=1)**_ demanding my opponent and Joe Biden forgo their government-funded health care services until every veteran who needs to be seen by a doctor is taken off the waitlist.
******************************************************[<< Add your name >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39220%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nwSLXXgWkgXkgj49m2Vj8w&sysid=1)******************************************************
**[As a Navy veteran,](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39221%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S6raUKvPlq4Gx9L77foPmQ&sysid=1)** I’m disgusted by the fact that my opponent is putting illegal immigrants ahead of American veterans--who risked their lives in defense of our freedoms and pay taxes as legal citizens--in the line for health care. It’s utterly shameful.

Every dollar used to pay for the health care of illegal migrants at the expense of our vets is THEFT.

We owe our veterans _everything_. The freedoms we enjoy as Americans are only possible due to the sacrifices of those in the Armed Forces who have put everything on the line for God and Country.

**[If this news makes your blood boil like it does mine, let me know by signing my petition to strip Democrats of their health care until this program is defunded.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39222%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AJyuXrW%2blKwsnDAkBUCYwA&sysid=1)**

For America’s Future,

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39223%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FINqyeBkGKet4L8T4UBe%2fw&sysid=1)
Tim Sheehy

body:
Thanks to Democrat Jon Tester, illegal immigrants are being given access to VA health care services before Veterans

Friend-

In 2021, the Senate Veterans Affairs Committee approved more than **[$70 million in federal funds to pay for health care costs incurred by illegal migrants.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb68jg0l0uc1rfhqm3hbib24u39tm48d3jqnmdqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)** More recently, the Committee approved more than $90 million to care for migrants crossing our border illegally.

Democrats charged the Department of Veterans Affairs with administering health care services to **[illegal migrants](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi4hbfp3dnquj7lvtmlk73sik1ar9f3ri3p2gmmo_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)** due to the sophisticated network of hospitals and clinics that were built to serve our veteran communities in all 50 states.

**[My opponent, Democrat Jon Tester, is the Committee 's chairman.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu4bpordthmirnv8o8uhrpqrut9c2cqiqt6lq778_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)**

_Every time an illegal migrant is cared for at one of our nation 's VA facilities, our veterans pay the price.

Help me defeat him. Chip in anything you can to help me defeat this Democrat and get veterans the health care they need. It's time to stop prioritizing illegal migrants over American service members._

Thanks to my opponent and Joe Biden, it's reasonable for a veteran on the backlog list to expect **[they may never get the care](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcotdme8980kk65vrhbglktbn4b6fgtuall7abeo_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)** they need due to the president of the United States and Senate Democrats prioritizing illegals over veterans.

**[_Friend, don 't you think it's a double standard that President Biden and Democrat Jon Tester are eligible to see the best doctors in the world at Walter Reed Medical Center just outside of DC - WITH NO WAIT TIME - while illegal migrants are given priority over veterans at VA facilities?_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkahfm18j4g309n78qsrbvcbhffkdeb26aomk4tg_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)**

_**[Sign my petition](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zf071m501p9o88up0ia7add2psejtn3f3srv3tu8_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)**_ demanding my opponent and Joe Biden forgo their government-funded health care services until every veteran who needs to be seen by a doctor is taken off the waitlist.

**[As a Navy veteran,](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3v70rm0vtmlvtgpj9eumiec8ano03d03a8ohv8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj6cor3c9h2bs)** I'm disgusted by the fact that my opponent is putting illegal immigrants ahead of American veterans--who risked their lives in defense of our freedoms and pay taxes as legal citizens--in the line for health care. It's utterly shameful.

Every dollar used to pay for the health care of illegal migrants at the expense of our vets is THEFT.

We owe our veterans _everything_. The freedoms we enjoy as Americans are only possible due to the sacrifices of those in the Armed Forces who have put everything on the line for God and Country.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Six years ago, I made a promise to the parents of Parkland
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
This fight is personal to me, friend
| | |
---
Friend,

Six years ago, 17 children and faculty members were murdered in Parkland, Florida. They were taken away from their families — their futures ripped away from them — by a brutal act of gun violence.
I will never forget that day, nor will I forget meeting with the families of the students who were killed. I wanted so badly to take away their pain, lessen their grief. But that's impossible. **All that you can do is listen, offer comfort however you can, hold their hands, and do everything within your power to win them the justice they deserve.**
**This fight is personal to me, friend — as both someone who lost her father to gun violence and as a mom.** Although I cannot even begin to imagine the pain and grief that the Parkland families carry, I do know what it feels like to have your loved one ripped away from you. And I know how scary it is to be a parent these days. There are some days when just dropping off your child at school feels like the hardest, most frightening thing you could do.
**Six years ago, when I was running for Congress for the first time, I made a promise to the Parkland families. I swore that I would never stop fighting for gun safety reforms until we win, until we pass the reforms that will protect other children and families from this horrible pain. That's a promise that I've fought tirelessly to keep.**
One of the most meaningful moments of my time in Congress was passing a universal background check bill. We spent _11 hours_ fighting to get this bill out of committee. Far-right extremists pulled out every trick they had to stop this bill from advancing. It wasn't until almost midnight that we were finally able to get it across the finish line.
Even though we knew that bill would be all but doomed in Mitch McConnell's Senate, that fight _mattered._ It remains one of my proudest moments in public service. **As I watched the activists from March for Our Lives celebrating in the House gallery, I realized for the first time the power that my vote holds — the power that _all of us_ wield when we cast our ballots.**
Today, I am holding the families of Parkland and everyone affected by senseless gun violence in my heart. And I'm recommitting myself to this fight once again. It doesn’t need to be like this. We can never give up. Not until we win. I hope you will join me.
With gratitude,

Debbie

And I know how scary it is to be a parent these days. There are some days when just dropping off your child at school feels like the hardest, most frightening thing you could do. Six years ago, when I was running for Congress for the first time, I made a promise to the Parkland families. I swore that I would never stop fighting for gun safety reforms until we win, until we pass the reforms that will protect other children and families from this horrible pain. That's a promise that I've fought tirelessly to keep. One of the most meaningful moments of my time in Congress was passing a universal background check bill. We spent 11 hours fighting to get this bill out of committee. Far-right extremists pulled out every trick they had to stop this bill from advancing. It wasn't until almost midnight that we were finally able to get it across the finish line. Even though we knew that bill would be all but doomed in Mitch McConnell's Senate, that fight mattered. It remains one of my proudest moments in public service. As I watched the activists from March for Our Lives celebrating in the House gallery, I realized for the first time the power that my vote holds — the power that all of us wield when we cast our ballots. Today, I am holding the families of Parkland and everyone affected by senseless gun violence in my heart. And I'm recommitting myself to this fight once again. It doesn’t need to be like this. We can never give up. Not until we win. I hope you will join me. With gratitude, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

subject: I'm new. 👋 Introductions
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
Introducing Dani Revord
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Dr. Bob is expanding his team. Your contributions are helping us fund our expanding talent pool and energizing voters in Michigan’s 1st District. If you’ve saved your payment information with Act Blue Express, your donation will process immediately:
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Hi, Friend.
My name is Dani Revord. I hail from Iron Mountain, and I'm excited to announce that I've recently taken a position with Dr. Bob Lorinser's Campaign for US Congress in Michigan's 1st District.
I wanted to introduce myself to you today. I'm grateful to be named Bob's political director. I can't wait to galvanize our communities and rally behind a great candidate.
After spending over a decade in the Greater Kansas City area, I'm back in Iron Mountain and eager to do my part to help Democrats up and down the ballot in Northern Michigan and the UP.
My Background
I studied marketing at Michigan Technological University and have been in politics since 2018, serving in numerous US Senate and US House statewide and local elections.
I am giving back at MTU as the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Advisor for the Epsilon Lambda chapter of Delta Phi Epsilon.
I love spending time with my family and my two rescue dogs. I'm also passionate about gardening and basketball.
I started working in politics as a volunteer licking envelopes in the early '90s and have remained involved in several ways ever since. I hope to bring a depth and breadth of experience to the team.
I am so excited about Bob's campaign because this moment in our nation is profound, it requires serious leadership, experience, and knowledge.
Dr. Bob is the best candidate in this race, and to flip Michigan's 1st District, we need a uniter.
Doc is the right person to bring us together, and your contributions are helping us [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] expand our team. Grassroots donations allow me to work on my life's passion - electing great leaders who can create positive change in our communities.
I look forward to talking to you throughout the campaign. Please feel free to reach out to me, I'm happy to help.
-Dani

dani@votedrbob.com

Bob Lorinser for Congress
Northern Michigan, UP
Democrat, MI01

subject: Trump's coming to Michigan on Saturday

body:
Here’s what it means for our race.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1134%2E135344%2EGp9KmD)

In 2020, Donald Trump made more visits to Michigan than almost any other state in the country.
On Saturday, he's coming back. It will already be his 3rd trip in the 2024 race.
So what does his trip mean?
First, let's state the obvious: there is no winning the White House in 2024 without winning Michigan. That goes for Joe Biden, and that goes for Donald Trump.
So this trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits he gets more volunteer activity and he gets more media attention -- both things he wants for his campaign.
It's also a chance for him to rally and organize more Michigan donors, the small-dollar ones and the deep-pocketed ones that will fund huge independent expenditures in the state.
All of this impacts our race.
If someone turns out for Trump, there is a decent chance they are turning out for the Republican nominee in our Senate race.
But we are not powerless in this campaign.
Because every person we turn out in our race is also likely a vote to keep Trump out of the White House. And the truth is, we have always done better than most Democrats do in some of those "redder" parts of the state.
So this is a big moment for us. We need to do our best to match the energy Trump generates for Republicans in Michigan. Because it is not just our race and control of the Senate for Democrats on the line in Michigan, but it's also the White House.
So please:

It will already be his 3rd trip in the 2024 race. So what does his trip mean? First, let's state the obvious: there is no winning the White House in 2024 without winning Michigan. That goes for Joe Biden, and that goes for Donald Trump. So this trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits he gets more volunteer activity and he gets more media attention -- both things he wants for his campaign. It's also a chance for him to rally and organize more Michigan donors, the small-dollar ones and the deep-pocketed ones that will fund huge independent expenditures in the state. All of this impacts our race. If someone turns out for Trump, there is a decent chance they are turning out for the Republican nominee in our Senate race. But we are not powerless in this campaign. Because every person we turn out in our race is also likely a vote to keep Trump out of the White House. And the truth is, we have always done better than most Democrats do in some of those "redder" parts of the state. So this is a big moment for us. We need to do our best to match the energy Trump generates for Republicans in Michigan. body:
I am running for Congress to represent TX-15.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78982269/455074477/-1345170518?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTIzYzljYy00M2NiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6p7bmTiwj_vNuObVx5K32XWRz01rbwwrTBwiz6JT9-0=&emci=552cf663-f8ab-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=4123c9cc-43cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=19345617)
Hola Peter, I am running for Congress to represent TX-15.
In just a bit, I’m going to ask you to become a founding donor to our campaign. But first, I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m jumping into this race.
I come from a big family of immigrants, farm workers and entrepreneurs. My parents, immigrants who made their way to the Rio Grande Valley from Mexico, did a little bit of everything to make ends meet. But running Pulga (flea market) Los Portales, serving thousands of our community members on a weekly basis and helping dozens of working-class entrepreneurs start their businesses, defined my family's values — our South Texan values.
But my life changed forever when I was in college. While at Columbia University, after years of fighting multiple sclerosis, my mother took her last breath at just 46 years old. It was then I decided the best way to honor her legacy is to fight for a better future for my family.
To fight for a better future for ALL of us — including you, Peter.
Every day, I see how hard the people of South Texas work just to scrape by. At our family’s pulga, dozens of vendors come each week, hoping to make enough to put food on the table. They are the overlooked emprendedores who make our community strong.
I’m working for stronger and healthier neighborhoods in TX-15 and I have a plan to make this happen.
It starts with fighting for quality affordable healthcare, protecting workers, providing good-paying jobs and a thriving economy, protecting women’s reproductive rights — and that’s just the beginning.
**[But to accomplish all of this, I need your help to jumpstart this campaign and put us in the best possible position as we launch this campaign. Can you make a contribution and become a founding donor today? What we are able to raise in these early days will be our first chance to show the state — and our opponents — just how much grassroots power we have.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78982270/455074478/1640391652?refcode=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTIzYzljYy00M2NiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6p7bmTiwj_vNuObVx5K32XWRz01rbwwrTBwiz6JT9-0=)**
**[Become a founding donor](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78982271/455074479/1640391652?refcode=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTIzYzljYy00M2NiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6p7bmTiwj_vNuObVx5K32XWRz01rbwwrTBwiz6JT9-0=)**
We’re at a critical moment for the future of South Texas. In South Texas, Monica De La Cruz makes a lot of promises to us, la gente. But in Congress, her record tells a different story. Her budget bill makes devastating cuts, from slashing veterans’ health care to taking away millions from our schools, and even jeopardizing Medicare and Social Security.
What’s more, she’d let the government interfere in women’s private medical decisions and take away our freedoms.
She wants to distract us with extremist issues in hopes that we won’t notice how badly her policies are hurting our communities. And, more importantly, so that we won’t notice how powerful we can be if we all come together to fight for a better world.
South Texas needs an advocate — no a una politica vendida.
I’m not afraid of the fight ahead because I’ve been underestimated and questioned before. Time and time again while growing up, I dealt with questions about why I spoke Spanglish, or why I mixed English and Spanish, about how I wore my curly hair and whether it looked too frizzy or if it was professional enough.
But instead of letting that change me, I chose to proudly represent my roots through my education and work. It’s why I decided to return to the Rio Grande Valley and get to work.
And it’s something I’ll continue in this fight to become your next Congresswoman of TX-15.
¡Vamos Por Quince!
Michelle Vallejo

This resolution is the critical first step to clearing President Trump’s name and setting the record straight once and for all. **[So please, become a citizen co-sponsor to the resolution to exonerate President Trump](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39234%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=03TtIEfMsbJwaBSI6lVAMA&sysid=1).**

name: David Nammo, Christian Legal Society
subject: The Fight to Protect Christian Attorneys
body:
This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life ...

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvrvgragnfn8msj4gbmp7e8mi0a9qh7k6o1ggv78_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs)
---
Dear Friend, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life ... _yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it!_ **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith—like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can’t be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** —IMPOSSIBLE to pursue... ...and leave Christians and Americans of faith alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools without ANY legal defense when they wrongly, and unconstitutionally, face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Dear Friend, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** **[**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2o3a9hpdahuosqc1q037hbgcgjs10n8l6jmfj10_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs)**
---
[Support Christian Legal Society](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh2tp4l2gcgf7d11putd9o58ejj1c3kmbamoqgng_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs)
---
For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has _devastating_ real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys**—**and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend** —**seems to be the _sole goal_ of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed ... without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that **radical activists could use this to** :
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as “progressive” or “Woke”);

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches** , sitting on church boards, or serving schools they’ve gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing _pro bono_ work to defend religious freedom **on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Dear Friend, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America ... but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. But to make sure we WIN this fight—and preserve religious freedom and protection for Christian attorneys and, by extension, all Americans of faith—I'm counting on your support. **[**Can I count on your generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help Christian Legal Society save these critical protections for Christian attorneys ... and every ministry, nonprofit, or believer that those same attorneys would defend?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc7745na8lm4hg1vfb7p2jt6j2u1l7ia8gmp1s4o_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs)**
---
[Support Christian Legal Society](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhof3dv3onl58tsoukslbi1daq0ujl9l2qil8rmg_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs)
---
Since 1961, Christian Legal Society has been a fellowship of Christians dedicated to serving Jesus Christ through the practice and study of law, the defense of religious freedom and life, and the provision of legal aid to the needy. And for nearly 50 years, Christian Legal Society’s Center for Law & Religious Freedom, which is spearheading the response to this proposed rule change, has defended and advanced all Americans’ inalienable rights to religious freedom and life in the public square. **No other organization is leading the charge to defend Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith on this critical issue like Christian Legal Society.**
[**That's why I encourage you** —**and hope** —**that you'll make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help Christian Legal Society WIN critical victories in the battles still to come.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfqdi5ktf1uk6bsh4ftkj7v280ac4evg0do9knb0_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjj69o30cjh2bs) Thank you for your support and for your prayerful consideration. David Nammo Executive Director & CEOChristian Legal Society

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Six years since the tragedy in Parkland, Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
Today, we come together to mark six years since the tragedy at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida.
Everything about the morning of February 14, 2018 was ordinary. After all, on Valentine's Day, the only atypical part of a student’s school day should be giving cards, candy, and flowers to friends or significant others. But the afternoon of this Valentine's Day at Stoneman Douglas turned into an unfathomable nightmare.
Students were evacuated from the school while a gunman opened fire with an assault weapon in hallways and classrooms. Police officers rushed in with their guns drawn to stop the assailant. Students and teachers texted friends and family members, unsure of their fate.
Fourteen students and three teachers were killed by the gunman in Parkland. Seventeen innocent lives were stolen in a matter of minutes. Seventeen families have a permanent empty seat at their dinner tables.
Unfortunately, we know that Parkland was not the end of these horrific tragedies in our nation’s schools. On February 13th of last year, a shooter opened fire on Michigan State University’s campus, leaving three students dead.
It doesn’t have to be this way. We are better than this constant fear and carnage. So many survivors became courageous advocates against gun violence after the Parkland shooting, and we’ve made real progress. But we still have much more work to do.
Just last month, a Florida House committee voted to repeal part of the Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School Public Safety Act, which would allow teenagers to buy rifles like the one the shooter used in the Parkland shooting. At the federal level, we must continue to work towards a future where commonsense measures like universal background checks are a reality.
Today, I hope you’ll join me in honoring the victims of the tragedy in Parkland with action. [**If you’re able to, you can use this link to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC to fuel our work toward safer communities.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb24.CYoP11&refcode=em240214-1-60&t=1&akid=7641%2E3935704%2ElGtT5O)
We cannot rest until we see a future where our children and our communities are safe. Thank you for standing with me in this journey towards a better future.
With courage,
Gabby Giffords
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb24.CYoP11&refcode=em240214-1-60&t=2&akid=7641%2E3935704%2ElGtT5O)**

Dear Peter,
Immigration is the #1 concern among voters, according to a recent public opinion poll.
Voters also say that President Biden’s open border policy has been a complete disaster.
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. couldn’t agree more.
Six months ago, RFK, Jr. visited the southern border in Yuma, Arizona. Last week, he returned to southern Arizona __to find the situation has become much worse__.
Fentanyl and methamphetamine flood our country, killing more and more Americans every day.
The worst kind of organized crime pours into our streets, towns, and cities.
Migrants are routinely robbed, raped, kidnapped, and sex trafficked.
Conscience demands we act immediately to stop the waves of illegal immigration so we can return to the orderly, lawful immigration policies our nation was founded upon.
The first step to end this crisis is to reassert control over our border . . . [which is exactly what RFK Jr. will do on his first day as President of the United States](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1rs_1_nd&n=3).

[CONTRIBUTE $240 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crisis_2_13_24_email_1rs_1_nd&n=8)

So far, Biden has refused to act.
Donald Trump wants Republicans to kill this legislation so he can then blame Joe Biden while he’s campaigning this fall.
In other words: one presidential candidate doing nothing to close the border wants to criticize the other presidential candidate who is also doing nothing to close the border.
_It’s politics as usual._

RFK, Jr. visited Cochise County, Arizona this week to see firsthand the humanitarian crisis and the current administration’s egregious mismanagement of the situation at our southern border.
The victims of our open border policy are the immigrants themselves. Compassion and decency demand that we do not allow the current situation to continue.
That’s why we must act today! We deserve a president who will respond to this unsustainable crisis in our country.

A software meltdown left over one million students and teachers offline Tuesday morning in the first real test of Democratic Mayor Eric Adam’s no-snow day strategy, according to Politico. body:
I know our campaign can defeat Hawley and flip this Senate seat. But here’s the situation:
#
Peter — I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat because I want to take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and put real working people in charge.
**As a born-and-raised Missourian who relied on friends and neighbors when my parents went bankrupt from my sister’s medical bills, I know that working people know how to take care of each other in this state.** And after serving 13 years in the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given my family so much, I know what it means to stand up and fight for our state and our country.
Over the last year, we’ve managed to build one of the most powerful grassroots movements in the entire country — breaking records, collecting critical endorsements, and even making this a margin of error race with Josh Hawley. And we’ve done it all without taking a cent from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs.
**I know our campaign can defeat Hawley and flip this Senate seat in November.**
It’s not going to be easy. After all, DC insiders have attacked me since the day I got into this race. But I know that if we keep strengthening this movement together, we’ll have what it takes to fight back and win. That’s why I’m reaching out:
Today is the official midpoint of our first fundraising quarter of 2024 and frankly, we’re tracking behind on our goal. **I’ll meet with the team a little later today and we’ll evaluate whether it’s possible to hit this goal of 25,000 individual donations before midnight or not.**

clean_body: I know our campaign can defeat Hawley and flip this Senate seat. But here’s the situation: Peter — I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat because I want to take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and put real working people in charge. As a born-and-raised Missourian who relied on friends and neighbors when my parents went bankrupt from my sister’s medical bills, I know that working people know how to take care of each other in this state. And after serving 13 years in the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given my family so much, I know what it means to stand up and fight for our state and our country. Over the last year, we’ve managed to build one of the most powerful grassroots movements in the entire country — breaking records, collecting critical endorsements, and even making this a margin of error race with Josh Hawley. And we’ve done it all without taking a cent from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs. I know our campaign can defeat Hawley and flip this Senate seat in November. It’s not going to be easy. After all, DC insiders have attacked me since the day I got into this race. But I know that if we keep strengthening this movement together, we’ll have what it takes to fight back and win. That’s why I’m reaching out: Today is the official midpoint of our first fundraising quarter of 2024 and frankly, we’re tracking behind on our goal. I’ll meet with the team a little later today and we’ll evaluate whether it’s possible to hit this goal of 25,000 individual donations before midnight or not. But before I do, I have to ask: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Missourians have spent the last three election cycles taking back their power at the ballot box by rejecting anti-union “Right-to-Work” laws, raising the minimum wage, expanding healthcare, and legalizing weed. This year, we’re going to make it four by defeating Josh Hawley and electing a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. Thanks for everything, — Lucas | | Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

| | Hi there, Peter!

This is Kathianne, Brian’s wife. Today I’m sending you lots of love for your support to Brian’s campaign. Whether it’s been donating money, sharing social media posts, displaying a yard sign, buying merchandise (did you see the tote and tee I designed?), or volunteering, it all helps. And we are so grateful. This year, I want to give Brian an extra special Valentine while he’s hard at work on the campaign trail. Today isn't just Valentine's Day, it's also **Brian’s last FEC filing deadline** before the primary on March 5 — and his team has a goal of raising $100,000.

[**Help me give Brian a donation boost before tonight's FEC deadline; donate $14 to help make sure his campaign has all the resources to win on March 5 >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/78993506/455107750/1248488860?refcode=em24_240214_Finalfiling6_fnd_gq_act___KSW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240214_Finalfiling6_fnd_gq_act___KSW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=a7f228ea-4dcb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTdmMjI4ZWEtNGRjYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=R8pMkGMNqTUbd4Sqizx3THEtbSOH8xeMZ4SghEBijJU=)

Since it’s Valentine’s Day, let me share a story about the love of my life.

On July 4th, 2001, I walked into a bar in Boston and my life changed forever. (Yes, we met in a bar, and during Brian’s first week of surgical residency.) When we first started dating, Brian was working 120+ hours a week. NINE more years of surgical training followed in two different states. Somehow we made it work. It’s been A LOT of alone time for me with him working long hours and nights, holidays, and weekends.

For the past 22 years, we've built a life together; we got married, adopted our daughter, and moved several times across the country for his career. By the grace of God, we survived everything life’s thrown at us so far but this political stuff is a different beast 😉.

Brian's responsibility to his patients, his sense of duty to our country, and his commitment to building a better world for all families are reasons why I love him. They are also reasons why being married to him can drive me nuts! I ask myself, “Why can’t he take the easy path for once?!” But when Brian believes in the mission, he’s all in. Just like he didn’t hesitate to start a second career at age 28 that took 13 (!) years of rigorous training, he won’t hesitate to throw himself all in with being a Congressman. He believes in the mission of protecting us all from gun violence, health inequities, unsafe abortion laws, and fighting for our country’s democracy.

**Brian’s love language is acts of service.** His love for our family, our neighbors, and this community is what drives him to serve — as a veteran, trauma surgeon, and a future member of Congress.

I’m so proud of my husband for choosing to **Be the Change** , and I’m so grateful he has you by his side on this campaign. As we face the FEC filing deadline, [**I hope you’ll help me send some love to Brian with a donation of $14. clean_body: | | Hi there, Peter! This is Kathianne, Brian’s wife. Today I’m sending you lots of love for your support to Brian’s campaign. Whether it’s been donating money, sharing social media posts, displaying a yard sign, buying merchandise (did you see the tote and tee I designed?), or volunteering, it all helps. And we are so grateful. = This year, I want to give Brian an extra special Valentine while he’s hard at work on the campaign trail. Today isn't just Valentine's Day, it's also Brian’s last FEC filing deadline before the primary on March 5 — and his team has a goal of raising $100,000. = Since it’s Valentine’s Day, let me share a story about the love of my life. On July 4th, 2001, I walked into a bar in Boston and my life changed forever. (Yes, we met in a bar, and during Brian’s first week of surgical residency.) When we first started dating, Brian was working 120+ hours a week. NINE more years of surgical training followed in two different states. Somehow we made it work. It’s been A LOT of alone time for me with him working long hours and nights, holidays, and weekends. For the past 22 years, we've built a life together; we got married, adopted our daughter, and moved several times across the country for his career. By the grace of God, we survived everything life’s thrown at us so far but this political stuff is a different beast 😉. Brian's responsibility to his patients, his sense of duty to our country, and his commitment to building a better world for all families are reasons why I love him. They are also reasons why being married to him can drive me nuts! I ask myself, “Why can’t he take the easy path for once?!” But when Brian believes in the mission, he’s all in. Just like he didn’t hesitate to start a second career at age 28 that took 13 (!) years of rigorous training, he won’t hesitate to throw himself all in with being a Congressman. He believes in the mission of protecting us all from gun violence, health inequities, unsafe abortion laws, and fighting for our country’s democracy. Brian’s love language is acts of service. His love for our family, our neighbors, and this community is what drives him to serve — as a veteran, trauma surgeon, and a future member of Congress. I’m so proud of my husband for choosing to Be the Change , and I’m so grateful he has you by his side on this campaign. name: Katie Porter
subject: Valentine’s Day 2018
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37634%2E3422442%2EQEo3D3)
On Valentine’s Day 2018, my three kids and I filed my petitions to run for Congress for the very first time. Looking at these pictures now I see how much the kids have grown—my oldest is headed off to college in the fall!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240214-1?refcode=em20240214-37634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37634_3422442_QEo3D3&akid=37634%2E3422442%2EQEo3D3)
**I don’t stand for the BS of Washington because there’s a real cost to me every time I get on that plane—leaving my kids behind.**
I first ran for Congress because as a consumer protection attorney I saw how beholden Washington was to corporate special interests, and how those special interests were making it difficult for families to get ahead.
Each time I’ve raised my hand to run again, I’ve done so because I truly believe that we can make a difference. Because I’ve seen how desperately Washington needs someone to shake it up. I’m in this fight because I don’t want my kids to continue to grow up with fewer rights than I had at their age. I don’t want them to have to leave California as adults because they can’t afford to live here. And I don’t want them to go to school in fear of gun violence.
**That’s why I’m running in the most difficult race of my life. In the past week, two separate super PACs have placed massive ad buys against us. We’re at risk of being drowned out and losing our primary on March 5th.**
So, on the anniversary of a Valentine’s Day that I’ll never forget—**[I’m wondering if you can chip in $5, $15, or even $50.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240214-1?refcode=em20240214-37634&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37634_3422442_QEo3D3&akid=37634%2E3422442%2EQEo3D3)** It would mean so much, and can help us pull ahead in these final 20 days of the race.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240214-1?refcode=em20240214-37634&refcode2=37634_3422442_QEo3D3&akid=37634%2E3422442%2EQEo3D3)
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240214-37634&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=37634_3422442_QEo3D3&akid=37634%2E3422442%2EQEo3D3)**

| | **Today,[I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f2552a1c47e746b3b363cd7877df81cc&_e=lljBwIxlT5QdkDYCDaBnm-sLuHw-stK1jEpq5ZZxIExnvMR_fA354E62aFDS_hq910NOJcc32Q-Uoe5Jl2Lbl5pucFgOR73Ifb7uorRazVjtbcxBZIIRQvp0ysf_8NsDmoCoEn1lkV2gRRuRpPAlFbsnIGXpSeXrqrkLZQFGf4jk9inXYLR1SSEGabBtRIJPewI_0A9F0C1mslxjAPtcSYXBUMDf9CgtpUzSAjpwDWFhpjFBCZBzJ0qY42iL4IVsUuNAJsN5CvrkNCY3mRYPQHTuWxQrO0kATS0i_OqFj1SduIZTU0TTZ3p4QUrtS-8Rts8kqqga2Jo51yHD2wi8uvv7ts65S66Z8ZJFv_t7meslYTjEhV6gh6ndDnnFmUyyeLp_Nih3na7jU-l65xj-iw%3D%3D)** Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: \- Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** \- Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. **_Remember?_** \- Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. **_Remember??_** Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they _welcome_ the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us." But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... **_We Republicans_ ****pulled our country out of that 1970 's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.** **We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.** **And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.** _**We can do that again**_**.** **It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.** **But there 's no way I can pull it off without you.** **That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today** I'm sorry for the urgency but _the primary is in less than three months_ and here's where things stand... In March, I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November general election. Adam Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on his heels for the #2 spot. Once we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -\- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -\- a very real shot -- of landing smack behind Schiff in the primary so we can go on to beat him in the general election. But there are just three months left until the primary. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. **[**When you rush back your _Garvey for Senate_ campaign contribution of $35 or more...**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f2552a1c47e746b3b363cd7877df81cc&_e=lljBwIxlT5QdkDYCDaBnm-sLuHw-stK1jEpq5ZZxIExnvMR_fA354E62aFDS_hq910NOJcc32Q-Uoe5Jl2Lbl5pucFgOR73Ifb7uorRazVjtbcxBZIIRQvp0ysf_8NsDmoCoEn1lkV2gRRuRpPAlFbsnIGXpSeXrqrkLZQFGf4jk9inXYLR1SSEGabBtRIJPewI_0A9F0C1mslxjAPtcSYXBUMDf9CgtpUzSAjpwDWFd3KcZ1S7VYCmsWlcbENbDd6gjFWTKpNcMHwIqmKzvKMlbNwAYqdKdrd3OxjdQmyeWlfRa-oJikq-7L6GCOWCdGk2LYbRdDkanFt1pO3y6wgfWl8sOJjA2Banhhif81jlekcamsTgVK08GsSxtg-hbeBNG-tWFTn9erHwdjRHYEw%3D%3D)** ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: _You don 't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less safe, less prosperous, and less free. _ This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -\- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. I'm fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I'm not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on you! You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can **[**step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of victory**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f2552a1c47e746b3b363cd7877df81cc&_e=lljBwIxlT5QdkDYCDaBnm-sLuHw-stK1jEpq5ZZxIExnvMR_fA354E62aFDS_hq910NOJcc32Q-Uoe5Jl2Lbl5pucFgOR73Ifb7uorRazVjtbcxBZIIRQvp0ysf_8NsDmoCoEn1lkV2gRRuRpPAlFbsnIGXpSeXrqrkLZQFGf4jk9inXYLR1SSEGabBtRIJPewI_0A9F0C1mslxjAPtcSYXBUMDf9CgtpUzSAjpwDWG2aMLTweN62bQwFdR1ffuxseMr9fOdWvd2JEegGMLX6isUbZL_72DY_r9IAu6UjHpFWZx4uj0g4qfUaoIiHgSxDGdm2QSxVv8Axi5oBsg75mbc05zcClQRSIgUjThWaBX4p6_-n5fudKidZ4kwj_ksgRNi0PDgky7c3bGeAwYETQ%3D%3D)**. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're winning for all of America. Thank you and God Bless,
