Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy, a Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

If you’re hearing from me for the first time today, here is a quick rundown of who I am, why I’m running, and why **[it’s critical that you join President Trump in endorsing my campaign for the U.S. Senate today.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=0c90c7b4d7f04375945fccacaeefa117&_e=eN7Y-cCCB2q1SkjZTbq4SvSxPSL-KEFv9ePFt-kttTjOpEXnlPhMuZXBylF_pVId93VgutUpvA56Wfk_L9NxowytDHrI7lOiuarFnSObD3jeJuX3Er-AmKVH2YLUPM77eIxg8yiAmCJTcZn5kbFBz4Xn2QOQxaECOs_y97ADmPVf4eEI6ejr6GlLHD54sItKrFHAyoxZyadiQcIp6byDMJ9kwXq3FQ49VLkQUIeHBU_jJWjYrg87Iha9KKpZApXHowZv5NvXDZdMXeU90ILVNwOwIQ53gTvxmGs2iYX9KokMfuLYeFUWW8UCdX_9L0ZZKKvtYyQYGbAd1RuvJKiwcaMKlte4ZbXIPeMZLl8QgznaiivBjs0ICzUPPyuwNV6NWq5kn2iMextUCxkpHnC3c0GTBEi68G5yPMci-pG4K19AhvcMgwLkJWr5iW4yZZJcRjIY1ZjXdOnLaOw-HYKCgA%3D%3D)**

**Unlike Joe Biden** , I understand what it is to serve our country, not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I have been wounded in service of our nation. I’ve lost mentors and friends who willingly made the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=0c90c7b4d7f04375945fccacaeefa117&_e=eN7Y-cCCB2q1SkjZTbq4SvSxPSL-KEFv9ePFt-kttTjOpEXnlPhMuZXBylF_pVId93VgutUpvA56Wfk_L9NxowytDHrI7lOiuarFnSObD3jeJuX3Er-AmKVH2YLUPM77eIxg8yiAmCJTcZn5kbFBz4Xn2QOQxaECOs_y97ADmPVf4eEI6ejr6GlLHD54sItKrFHAyoxZyadiQcIp6byDMJ9kwXq3FQ49VLkQUIeHBU_jJWjYrg87Iha9KKpZApXHowZv5NvXDZdMXeU90ILVNwOwIQ53gTvxmGs2iYX9KonQ3mwT9DhYwQ7jWh1ewf_PSfjL5t1abN4HaE98-EHIzmdNaTscDXXwK072UgRtMyC_FH4ySfNEc5y5zaOXv8yeQhQ0x40jJStIUvdN425_J209RXHPckO9_uHDRAhb0DvufV6GmzAf63HrfeEutBNbt6MIjojPguIJrYprN7rvYg%3D%3D)
**Like President Trump** , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. Donald Trump knows that Montanans - and Americans across the country - want more _**conservative political outsiders**_ representing their interests in the U.S. Senate. That’s why, on Friday, February 9th, he formally endorsed my campaign for the U.S. Senate.

**[Will you follow President Trump’s lead and personally endorse my Senate campaign today?](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=0c90c7b4d7f04375945fccacaeefa117&_e=eN7Y-cCCB2q1SkjZTbq4SvSxPSL-KEFv9ePFt-kttTjOpEXnlPhMuZXBylF_pVId93VgutUpvA56Wfk_L9NxowytDHrI7lOiuarFnSObD3jeJuX3Er-AmKVH2YLUPM77eIxg8yiAmCJTcZn5kbFBz4Xn2QOQxaECOs_y97ADmPVf4eEI6ejr6GlLHD54sItKrFHAyoxZyadiQcIp6byDMJ9kwXq3FQ49VLkQUIeHBU_jJWjYrg87Iha9KKpZApXHowZv5NvXDZdMXeU90ILVNwOwIQ53gTvxmGs2iYX9KonzIy-12uMybOrDeYf1rM5vl66huWpDxjd297L-URca401xm-tW0-jiEd4IUWsl4156osPqBTqEIYgHbWCrm0XANidppDyhXVZFriqpEVZv6Y356jMBel1mU7JCTT78mkJ5q-iBNBWvsl1Id0JZI9uegPtod6Jr5pcwRZeaJpz3CQ%3D%3D)**

**[Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=0c90c7b4d7f04375945fccacaeefa117&_e=eN7Y-cCCB2q1SkjZTbq4SvSxPSL-KEFv9ePFt-kttTjOpEXnlPhMuZXBylF_pVId93VgutUpvA56Wfk_L9NxowytDHrI7lOiuarFnSObD3jeJuX3Er-AmKVH2YLUPM77eIxg8yiAmCJTcZn5kbFBz4Xn2QOQxaECOs_y97ADmPVf4eEI6ejr6GlLHD54sItKrFHAyoxZyadiQcIp6byDMJ9kwXq3FQ49VLkQUIeHBU_jJWjYrg87Iha9KKpZApXHowZv5NvXDZdMXeU90ILVNwOwIQ53gTvxmGs2iYX9Kom5qH1D-cyYJp3Db_bzQCgVfzbPbFq1pi1hO_L5KUmKZHlI5_gD9Et_6mvkyo-Sna1qjhKFsfvQ1KMOHysaTi4NP6l9gIfWPKCQfgrQRyZhmjx1rB1ZlD7q_2ONtafcozYuKzXJoLF0Zc6fjUtSECC6rSqhgtX9Xdp4yVCVtfqMYw%3D%3D)** – and spend $100M plus in the process. As of last week, they’ve made public their plans to spend more than 56 million dollars attacking me on Montana airwaves later this year.

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-person job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit to defeat the enemy.

_**The Senate functions in much the same way.**_

_**President Trump knows this, which is why he’s endorsed my campaign.**_

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=0c90c7b4d7f04375945fccacaeefa117&_e=eN7Y-cCCB2q1SkjZTbq4SvSxPSL-KEFv9ePFt-kttTjOpEXnlPhMuZXBylF_pVId93VgutUpvA56Wfk_L9NxowytDHrI7lOiuarFnSObD3jeJuX3Er-AmKVH2YLUPM77eIxg8yiAmCJTcZn5kbFBz4Xn2QOQxaECOs_y97ADmPVf4eEI6ejr6GlLHD54sItKrFHAyoxZyadiQcIp6byDMJ9kwXq3FQ49VLkQUIeHBU_jJWjYrg87Iha9KKpZApXHowZv5NvXDZdMXeU90ILVNwOwIQ53gTvxmGs2iYX9KommujsbZMR_MErti83aJmnsGqHT98pWMQs_c0IHrczm0VKAe8uWpO8lzwXc4WvUQeqevnfGruY4DY0BM-UBFUeEA76yTvN6kh2p4Sc08gh7DeAl9EkdW8rog0AlA6oOuTd-mXgVal-lCOMktFrCEO9g9N9_bFHnAEoPLCGn2t7hWQ%3D%3D)
_**Kristi Noem, Tommy Tuberville, Kellyanne Conway, Marjorie Taylor Greene .... and many others also know I’m the only conservative in the race who can beat Jon Tester and flip this seat. They’ve all endorsed my campaign in recent months.**_

Republicans around the country know that to win back the Senate, we must flip Montana in the fall. But this won’t be an easy task; _**it will take thousands of hours working around the clock to get our message in front of every voter in Montana.**_

But I can tell you this: Every ounce of sweat and tears we put into this campaign will be worth winning on November 5th.

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of evil. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator**.

If you’re hearing from me for the first time today, here is a quick rundown of who I am, why I’m running, and why Unlike Joe Biden , I understand what it is to serve our country, not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I have been wounded in service of our nation. I’ve lost mentors and friends who willingly made the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Like President Trump , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. Donald Trump knows that Montanans - and Americans across the country - want more conservative political outsiders representing their interests in the U.S. Senate. That’s why, on Friday, February 9th, he formally endorsed my campaign for the U.S. Senate. – and spend $100M plus in the process. As of last week, they’ve made public their plans to spend more than 56 million dollars attacking me on Montana airwaves later this year. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-person job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit to defeat the enemy. The Senate functions in much the same way. President Trump knows this, which is why he’s endorsed my campaign. Kristi Noem, Tommy Tuberville, Kellyanne Conway, Marjorie Taylor Greene .... and many others also know I’m the only conservative in the race who can beat Jon Tester and flip this seat. They’ve all endorsed my campaign in recent months. Republicans around the country know that to win back the Senate, we must flip Montana in the fall. But this won’t be an easy task; it will take thousands of hours working around the clock to get our message in front of every voter in Montana. But I can tell you this: Every ounce of sweat and tears we put into this campaign will be worth winning on November 5th. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of evil. I've talked about "the line" before – the undemocratic system that lets top party bosses handpick their own candidates and manipulate the design of ballots to minimize the voices of regular voters.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79001782/455130704/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTdlMzU0Yy01NmNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-rshkXBV0MdHt4WKXORNH7F88CpZm7CM5k5vWjLqhyI=&emci=a90cba55-51cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=b17e354c-56cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=26261389)

| | I have something I'd like for you to read. I've talked about "the line" before – the undemocratic system that lets top party bosses handpick their own candidates and manipulate the design of ballots to minimize the voices of regular voters. Yesterday, a group of AAPI leaders in New Jersey published an op-ed in the New Jersey Monitor that shows how "the line" depresses and discourages Asian Americans who want to step up and serve their community and their country. This is what we're up against. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79001783/455130706/588986019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTdlMzU0Yy01NmNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-rshkXBV0MdHt4WKXORNH7F88CpZm7CM5k5vWjLqhyI=&emci=a90cba55-51cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=b17e354c-56cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=26261389) I want to share with you the short story that is in this article: During the pandemic, 32-year-old Hoan Huynh, a son of Vietnamese refugees who had built a successful career in social impact investing, was troubled by the way communities like his were being left behind. When a legislative district seat in Illinois became vacant, Huynh quit his job and started campaigning from dawn until dusk, greeting people outside train stations, visiting senior centers, and knocking on doors in every street in his district. He won a five-way primary whose runner-up was a well-financed candidate endorsed by the Illinois governor and leading Democrats. Easily winning the general election, Huynh became the first Vietnamese American and first refugee in the Illinois Legislature. **Would Huynh's story have been possible in New Jersey? Sadly, the answer is probably no.** If Huynh had been in New Jersey, instead of spending 14 hours a day connecting with voters, his time would have been better spent convincing a handful of unelected party leaders to award him "the line." ...Conferring an average advantage of 38 percentage points, "the county line" pushes primary candidates not favored by the party to more distant, less populated rows or columns on the ballot, giving otherwise competitive and viable candidates a dubious appearance that is difficult to overcome. **There are over 1.1 million AAPIs in New Jersey — the fastest growing demographic — but how many potential elected leaders are there who could make a difference for our communities, but are never allowed the chance?** Now, I'm running for Senate not to make history, but to restore representation to those who have been left out of our politics for too long. **It's time we root out corruption and elect real representation for New Jerseyans; I need your help to do it.** Thank you for reading, _Andy_ You can read the entire commentary [**here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79001784/455130708/588986019?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTdlMzU0Yy01NmNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-rshkXBV0MdHt4WKXORNH7F88CpZm7CM5k5vWjLqhyI=&emci=a90cba55-51cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=b17e354c-56cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=26261389). | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

Peter,

Agriculture is the lifeblood of our economy, especially here in Alabama. The American people rely on our state’s more than 40,000 farms to help put food on their tables.

Unfortunately, our agriculture industry is under threat from hostile foreign powers...

**Nations including China, Iran, North Korea, and Russia are buying up U.S. farmland – and today Alabama has the third-largest amount of foreign-held land at 1.8 million acres!**

As Coach has said, _“We can’t let our enemies hold our food supply hostage.”_

That’s why he’s introduced a number of measures in the U.S. Senate, including the Foreign Adversary Risk Management Act (FARM Act) and the Agricultural Foreign Investment Disclosure Improvements Act of 2024 (AFIDA), to address this critical issue.

Do you believe foreign influence in our agriculture industry is a threat we need to address? [**SIGN OUR PETITION IF YOU STAND WITH COACH >>>** ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/fb1dfcc83e5b948b3947229f28c3afba/6906973ae7225053c3d6b838967d376c/33013)

Today marks six years since the mass shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. Seventeen Americans were killed that day – seventeen lives lost, seventeen families torn apart, and a community that will never be the same.

Every day, gun violence devastates our communities and strikes at the core of who we are as a nation.

The gun violence epidemic is a uniquely American problem – it doesn’t have to be like this.

What happened in Parkland changed the tide as young people stood up and demanded better. They called on us to take on the NRA and keep our neighbors safe. They marched for their lives and they held our leaders accountable.

We must keep fighting to make sure everyone feels safe in our schools, our churches, our grocery stores, and our communities. The time to act is right now.

[Sign my petition to demand federal legislation to end gun violence.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79002365/455132434/-997108900?refcode=KBN_EM_PT_OP_240214_1_1&refcode2=604c2ffb-56cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM4MzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjA0YzJmZmItNTZjYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aE9cBtHhGeEgH2Ec4hkQen8CMktbHhwpLWM0eh2n1I8=&emci=939968c4-04ca-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=604c2ffb-56cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=9674971)

I’m running for Congress to keep our communities safe and take on the scourge of gun violence. I’ll stand up to the NRA and join President Biden in demanding commonsense policies like universal background checks and an assault weapons ban. And I promise that I will never stop fighting for what’s right.

Let’s get to work.

– Kim

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2fc0e24ab6b14083a34108f5fbe4be6f&_e=OdLAnw7zGmu0k7af6Y8HpuFr0eM6tow6nLZ53gob6P46H720vAR01n0LmuvCIdN3MZOZEg9bm74raA5DTtCRyXus_DhX_ffv1KDl5LL0_HVVy56F_lmMAF3sky4kDGoxKIYzYaXJkF5tWW8AK22OgpU9Ht6s_7wha9CGzcEEg1fnjJ7Yz9xbMu8gGxkC0dwkKV_QMBg1Ys24H6PduAatjNJaquUBw87q1pFPIgjT0lu9aP4Djg9CXw4Iix2CEivCEzR_BQW7YsfbsaekZhDQrVMoBiaO3M0kisj7TEs09gTqLYOlcK9baP8IeqQNibPYih9ul0ihUbiQtqDW9NXJ92bKxzUdVWF6QD-wrbuwJlRkKFunyaG6lPgOnaSg4d3PlEbeBir7DTeeOcHlhzrjVq1LlCp1ijtOdwm4eMb12o9POUuzlH4tWS0LlQq2sfMCpCE8gcHhFn09vAQUgDWM7A%3D%3D)
**Like President Trump** , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. Donald Trump knows that Montanans - and Americans across the country - want more _**conservative political outsiders**_ representing their interests in the U.S. Senate. That’s why, on Friday, February 9th, he formally endorsed my campaign for the U.S. Senate.

_**The Senate functions in much the same way.**_

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of evil. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator**.

# A Time for Love of Country: Saving America.
Friend and Supporter,

"Goodbye, America. The dream and promise of freedom is over." Is that what you want to happen in our lifetime - to forever lose the America we know? Will you tell your children and grandchildren of what America once was like, but was lost in our time? Never in our 247 years as a sovereign nation has it been so close to occurring.

I am the sole candidate in this race who WALKED OFF the House Floor as your State Delegate refusing to vote in support of sending our taxpayer money to WAR in UKRAINE.

Now, the U.S. Senate just funded Ukraine more money in one bill than the entire US Marine Corps budget for an entire year - all while treasonously keeping our Southern Border WIDE OPEN. Make no mistake - these actions are not loving, they are hatred for you and me and our Constitution and nation.

My primary opponents - none of whom have yet ENDORSED PRESIDENT TRUMP AS I HAVE - are each sadly mistaken. This is not a time to put fingers to the wind and take polls to see if they should speak for our nation as they have shockingly stated is their reason for running. And this is not a time to put forward a never-before-elected candidate who lives in District 8, or someone (at least THREE in this race) who has lived their whole professional life on government (taxpayer) payroll and never before has stepped up in this arena for you.

Marylanders do not want a "yes-man;" they want a proven doer as your Member of Congress. I humbly ask for your urgent support to help us reach our necessary fundraising goals.

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=43e47a23f5&e=5bb5efcda7)

And this is no time to surrender to the haters who claim that our way of life, our faith and our historic Christian values that support our Constitution are "hateful" like Democrats in this race falsely claim. _This is not a time for weak-kneed leadership. It is a time for love of country to save America from the destruction we are headed for if immediate change is not made._

At no time in history have we as Americans been in such peril. From the senile man in the White House exposing our nation to danger, to the Blanked-out CCP Mitch who just passed a treasonous $95 BILLION of our taxpayer money to hand out to the world while inviting a foreign invasion across our Borders, we need a strong voice in Congress to defend us.

In Western Maryland jobs are below poverty line for most young people, and rent, electricity, inflation and taxes are skyrocketing.

My Democrat opponents want to destroy our children with transgender surgery behind our backs and end our rights as parents and grandparents - that's not love, that's hatred. Democrats also falsely claim to be for the working poor and the environment, but they lie.

April McLain Delaney, a Biden-Admin lawyer in the NTIA supporting big Tech and against free speech, supports her husband's business Forthbright Bank - which has as its goal the elimination of oil & clean gas resources and use. Because of the Democrats like her, here in Western Maryland we have frozen job growth and stopped clean energy jobs, all while sitting on one of the largest oil and CLEAN ENERGY gas reserves in the world called the Marcellus Shale formation. And they want to keep the Border open and overthrow our Constitution. Why do they do this? Because they serve interests other than you and me. They don't want Western Maryland families to succeed and grow wealthy. They'd rather you be bankrupt, move out and then they and the CCP can buy up the land which is worth more than most of the Middle East.

_But thank God for the U.S. House of Representatives standing against these treasonous actions which serve foreign interests_. Speaker Johnson has pledged the foreign aid bill will not be voted on. I am the candidate who has pledged to stand with him - I will not vote for foreign aid handouts! I will work hard to open the Marcellus Shale and make Maryland and America great again with President Trump. Imagine - CLEANEST energy jobs right here in Maryland, making us WEALTHIER THAN DUBAI, whose last year GDP was $203 BILLION.

As your Member of Congress I will fight for you and work hard to resolve the issues that are costing us outrageous debt and putting our nation and our families at RISK of total loss of freedom.

HELP ME DEFEND OUR FREEDOM AND WIN THIS RACE. If I win the Primary, I will win the General. I am going to work hard for you and will keep my word. We must never surrender, we must never give up. Please help me today - thank you.

Freedom and Victory,

Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD-6)

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...

body:
#
Hi Derek, some big news for you:**
**I’m proud to endorse Nikil Saval for re-election to the State Senate from Pennsylvania’s 1st district.**
Senator Saval is exactly the type of leader we need in Harrisburg. Our views intersect on many issues, and sometimes not on others, but he’s willing to cross the aisle to get important things done. When I saw the relentless work and dedication he put in to the bipartisan Whole-Home Repairs legislation -- a true national model -- I knew that we had someone in the PA State Capitol who knows how to make things happen.
Nikil has my support so he can keep fighting for working people in PA.

Despite all evidence to the contrary, some lawmakers still think paid leave for all workers is a luxury, when it is very clearly an urgent need in every corner of the country.

**Women suffer the most.**

Not having a federal paid leave policy hurts parents welcoming a new child and working families who face cancer treatments, recoveries from severe injuries or other physical and mental health conditions. And it especially hurts low-income women, single mothers, and women of color – many of whom are breadwinners – whose families are less able to afford unpaid time off.

National paid family and medical leave means a stronger economy, healthier and more economically secure families, and greater equality for all women and families.

| | | The Trump classified documents trial is scheduled to begin in May, but Trump's lawyers keep taking new and ever more ridiculous steps to delay it. It's a naked attempt to delay the trial beyond the election, in the hopes that Trump could then pardon himself. We can't let that happen – Trump's mishandling of classified documents put our national security at risk. He clearly cannot be trusted with sensitive information, we cannot allow him anywhere near the White House, and he must be held accountable for his crimes! This trial needs to happen ASAP. The Trump judges need to stop letting him get away with these delays. We can't afford to wait any longer. subject: Biden must suspend weapons transfers and military funding to Israel
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In response to the case brought by South Africa against Israel, the
International Court of Justice just ruled that Israel’s government is
plausibly committing genocide.

The Court ordered Israel’s government to act immediately to prevent
further harm to the Palestinian people—and to stop “acts of genocide” such
as killing Palestinians and “causing serious bodily or mental harm” to
Palestinians.

This ruling also puts the U.S. government on notice for enabling
violations of the Genocide Convention. As a signer of the Genocide
Convention, the U.S. government is legally obligated to prevent genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140350?t=1001&akid=33325%2E1203867%2EwOP0wi ]Sign to tell President Biden: To comply with the International Court of
Justice’s ruling to prevent genocide, you must suspend all weapons
transfers and military funding to Israel’s government. Stop enabling the
genocide of Palestinians, and instead push for a ceasefire.

SIGN NOW

With U.S. support, the Israeli government has killed more than 27,000
Palestinians in Gaza, forcibly displacing 2 million people within the
already-densely-packed Gaza strip.

President Biden has sent thousands of bombs to Israel’s military, while
blocking international efforts to stop the violence and watering down
attempts to secure sufficient humanitarian aid.

Meanwhile, Israel’s government is still starving Palestinians in Gaza and
depriving the trapped population of other basic needs for survival such as
water, shelter, and medical assistance.

As the biggest funder of Israel’s military, U.S. government leaders have
the power and the obligation to stop this unfolding genocide.

In addition to the order to prevent genocide, the International Court of
Justice (ICJ) also ordered Israel to prevent and punish incitement to
genocide, to immediately ensure “urgently needed basic services and
humanitarian assistance” to Gaza, and to report back within a month to the
court.

The only way to implement the Court’s orders is by facilitating a lasting
ceasefire.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140350?t=1002&akid=33325%2E1203867%2EwOP0wi ]Please sign if you agree: The Biden administration must not only affirm
the legitimacy of the ICJ’s ruling and facilitate an immediate
ceasefire—it must comply with federal and international law by suspending
military assistance to the Israeli government.

ADD YOUR NAME

Let’s keep up the momentum and the pressure to end not only this genocide,
but also the apartheid system that’s rooted in the racist dehumanization
of Palestinians. Together, we’re demanding a world with equality and
dignity for all people.

In solidarity,

Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib

| | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240216_symposium_blast&n=1)

Friend, Many Americans may not know about Abraham Lincoln's great love for the plays, and especially the tragedies, of William Shakespeare. The sharing of a literate language culture was an essential component of the process by which Lincoln ennobled our nation and upheld our Constitution, in order to preserve the Union. Our conversation this Friday represents a continuation of that process. Join us to discuss the beautiful history of the true United States of America, by whose example we can pull our nation off of the course of self-destruction it has been set upon for the last six decades. _*** This Sunday, February 18th, our campaign is hosting a[President's Day Conference, America's Next Fifty Years](https://www.sareforsenate.com/presidents_day_conference?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240216_symposium_blast&n=2), with speakers including candidate for Congress NY-15 Jose Vega, Schiller Institute President Helga Zepp-LaRouche, and many others. I highly recommend attending in person, in Manhattan. Please RSVP at the following link: [https://www.sareforsenate.com/presidents_day_conference](https://www.sareforsenate.com/presidents_day_conference?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240216_symposium_blast&n=3) ***_ **NB: This week's symposium will be online only, at the live-stream linked below.**

Friend,

clean_body: 🦉 🍄 🦇🌲 Dear forest friend, It’s Valentine’s Day and we want to make sure you, our amazing redwoods supporters, know that our love for you spans root to canopy! To share our appreciation for all you do – and to celebrate the redwood forests we all love – we made you some special Valentine's cards: Whether you’re going out on a limb with a new love this Valentine’s Day or embracing a cozy night in sluggish-style, we hope your day is sweet. Thank you for your year-round love and care for the coast redwood and giant sequoia forests we call home. | | I remember this day like it was yesterday. I was 12 years old when I got to see a new president inaugurated in front of the Capitol building while the old one flew off on a helicopter from the back. I watched in awe as he took his oath of office. And just like that, a new era, a new vision, a new party, and a million new opportunities began, and the air was buzzing with hope. That day has stuck with me. I've been in awe of that remarkable transition of power ever since. Through good presidents and bad, I've always looked forward to heading to the ballot box and choosing _whichever candidate I want_ , because that memory has always reminded me that my voice matters. Until now – until this Republican candidate came along who won't accept when he loses fair and square, who runs on vengeance and leveling up scores, and who threatens every single bit of progress we've made since long before I witnessed that inauguration. **I no longer sit on the sidelines and hope for the best. I can't anymore. And neither can you.** [**So, chip in $3 and help rural county Dems organize and run up the vote totals for Joe Biden in supposed red areas and let's push him over the top in November!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016111/455166511/-327605227?refcode=2024-02-14-personal&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2e8b67a7-65cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZThiNjdhNy02NWNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-HXe2J8NL1rH5HXBYo7PfgiYOaHpZx8wWw0Y8iY1wRs=) [Donate Now](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016112/455166512/-327605227?refcode=2024-02-14-personal&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2e8b67a7-65cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZThiNjdhNy02NWNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-HXe2J8NL1rH5HXBYo7PfgiYOaHpZx8wWw0Y8iY1wRs=) Instead of waiting and hoping, I decided to take action. I love doing trainings and volunteering and hanging out with friends at canvass kickoffs. But after a while, I realized the things that I believe in – the things that make me a progressive through and through – things like a sustainable environment, equity and equal rights, the right to make my own decisions about my body, and having security and dignity in old age with Medicare and Social Security were getting chipped away bit by bit. Sometimes with a scalpel and sometimes with a hammer. Every time new headlines appeared showing how these rights were being systematically destroyed, my heart broke just a little more. But, I was determined to turn my heartbreak into change. I'd worked in nonprofits all my life, but when I saw that my values weren't being represented by my elected officials, I decided to jump all in with Movement Labs and use my skills to give tired activists in red states and rural communities a voice, to tell young people they're not too young to run for local office, to tell frustrated parents grumbling about their city council that they can run and become the City Councilor themselves. People deserve better, and that's a motto I've been committed to since I was 12 years old. It's time to take action. [**Join me and jump in, if you haven't already! Your contribution not only recruits local candidates and organizes rural and red state folks, it lays the foundation to send Joe Biden to a second term and win critical Congressional and Senate races across the country.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016113/455166513/-327605227?refcode=2024-02-14-personal&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=2e8b67a7-65cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZThiNjdhNy02NWNiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-HXe2J8NL1rH5HXBYo7PfgiYOaHpZx8wWw0Y8iY1wRs=) Onward to November, _Sarah_ Sarah Long

Hi, Derek, this is Bart. In a few moments, I'm going to ask you to support my incredible wife, Chrissy Houlahan, as she defends her seat in Congress.

**But first, let me tell you why:**
Chrissy has dedicated her entire life to service. I've watched her serve our nation in the Air Force, scale a small business, work to fix our education system in the Teach For America Corps, and become the world's best mother to our daughters. **And in the 30+ years I've stood by her, her commitment to service has made me _so incredibly proud to be her husband. _**
It was that same commitment that drove her to run for Congress back in 2018, and since then, she's fought every day to make life better for everyone in PA-06 by delivering on the things that matter to _your_ family.

**Today, I can undoubtedly say that Chrissy is the best person to represent Pennsylvania, to deliver commonsense solutions for our community, and to provide a steady hand in an unsteady world. name: Julia DeGraw
subject: Support a Strong Climate Budget!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters
body:
We're in the second week of the 2024 legislative session and we must make the case to lawmakers to continue making progress on climate. Will you urge your lawmakers to pass the strongest climate budget possible in 2024? [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016950/455169700/-1501998768?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwM2YzYWU3LTY3Y2ItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=79f35t7u7JJlRi6rJWjKjD43Y8sxWsZJPnxWhGJykYY=&emci=1b6a98e7-cdc9-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=003f3ae7-67cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter,

We're in the second week of the 2024 legislative session, and we must make the case to lawmakers to continue making progress on climate. [**Will you urge your lawmakers to pass the strongest climate budget possible in 2024?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016951/455169701/-1870012974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwM2YzYWU3LTY3Y2ItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=79f35t7u7JJlRi6rJWjKjD43Y8sxWsZJPnxWhGJykYY=&emci=1b6a98e7-cdc9-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=003f3ae7-67cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)

We must continue funding the incredible climate programs we passed over the last few years. This is why one of our top three priorities for this session is asking for a $50 million climate budget that prioritizes two things:

1) **A $15 million investment in the the Healthy Homes Program** to enable urgently-needed home repairs including health, safety and efficiency upgrades, and
2) **A $20 million investment in the Charge Ahead Electric Vehicle Rebate Program** to make new and used electric vehicles more affordable and accessible for lower-income Oregonians.

Together, these continued investments in successful programs that are running out of funding will lower the cost of living, improve health and resilience, and reduce climate pollution.

The Healthy Homes Grant Program will help us keep seniors, low-income, and frontline families in their homes. Solving Oregon’s housing crisis is about more than building new housing, it’s about reducing the cost of essential home repairs so that low-income families can live safely in the homes we already have.

The Healthy Homes Grant Program covers essential home repairs not typically funded by other state or federal programs, **and it’s likely to run out by 2025.** Frontline communities, including people of color, low-income, rural, and disabled communities are at the highest risk. [**That's why we need to continue funding the Healthy Homes Grant Program.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016952/455169702/-1870012974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwM2YzYWU3LTY3Y2ItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=79f35t7u7JJlRi6rJWjKjD43Y8sxWsZJPnxWhGJykYY=&emci=1b6a98e7-cdc9-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=003f3ae7-67cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)

We’re in a housing crisis and a climate crisis. Oregon must tackle both. Healthy Homes will help people on the frontlines stay housed by lowering the cost of living, improving health and resilience, and reducing climate pollution.

Our second major Climate Budget Priority is $20 million for affordable access to clean transportation through the Charge Ahead EV Rebates program. Everyone deserves a chance to participate in the green energy transition, but not everyone can afford to do so. The Charge Ahead Rebate offers low-and moderate-income Oregonians a $5,000 cash rebate for the purchase of a new or used EV in addition to a standard EV rebate.

EV drivers can save thousands of dollars on fuel and maintenance costs compared to gas-powered cars. Increasing equitable access to EVs can improve household budgets and reduce climate and air pollution. Electrifying vehicles is a top priority to reduce climate pollution from our biggest source: the transportation sector. [**Will you ask your lawmakers to support a strong Climate Budget including funding for EV rebates?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016953/455169703/-1870012974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwM2YzYWU3LTY3Y2ItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=79f35t7u7JJlRi6rJWjKjD43Y8sxWsZJPnxWhGJykYY=&emci=1b6a98e7-cdc9-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=003f3ae7-67cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)

Due to unprecedented demand, the Oregon Clean Vehicle Rebate Program, including the Charge Ahead Rebate program, ran out of funds, and the program entered suspension in 2023. **Without more funding now, the program will not be able to stay open for more than two months this year. **

We are also eager for Oregon legislators to prioritize investments to ensure that other popular existing programs are adequately funded to stay on track to deliver their intended climate, health, and cost-saving benefits, including the Worker Climate Fund; the Solar + Storage Rebate; and the Oregon Rental Home Heat Pump Program.

[**Please urge your lawmaker to support a strong Climate Budget in 2024 today!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79016954/455169704/-1870012974?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwM2YzYWU3LTY3Y2ItZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=79f35t7u7JJlRi6rJWjKjD43Y8sxWsZJPnxWhGJykYY=&emci=1b6a98e7-cdc9-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=003f3ae7-67cb-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=2107230)

Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: what I'm grateful for this Valentine's Day ❤️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
as corny as it may sound...
| | |
---
Hi there, friend, and happy Valentine's Day!
Today, I'm feeling very, very lucky for all of the love in my life. I have the most amazing husband. Robert is kind, unbelievably caring, and always so supportive. Raising our beautiful and compassionate children together, Willow, Jude, and Siena, has been the greatest gift. And throughout my entire life, my mom and my sisters have been my rock, guiding me, believing in me, and surrounding Robert, the kids, and me with unconditional love.
The love I'm grateful for stretches far beyond my family. **I've had the chance to build my home in the place I truly love most. Florida is unlike anywhere else in the world: **It's warm, bustling with life and music, and all so, so beautifully green. The diverse communities who live here are even warmer than the weather. They're welcoming, friendly, and fiercely proud to call this state their home.
It's been a privilege to spend my life giving back to Florida. I've helped protect the Everglades. I expanded access to health care. I’ve led efforts to pass gun safety reforms. And I fought tirelessly for my community as the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. Now, I'm running to serve this state that I love in the United States Senate.
**This campaign is about a lot of important issues, but at the end of the day, it really does come down to love, as corny as it may sound**. I love Florida and I'm fighting for the leadership and the fair policies that our families deserve. I'll lead with love, compassion, and a listening ear in Washington — not the division, extremism, and partisanship that have defined Rick Scott's time in office.
Thank you for being a part of this campaign, believing in leadership guided by love, and fighting for the state I love so much. I am so appreciative of all that you do.
With gratitude, and of course, love,

Debbie
**P.S. Unlike Rick Scott, I'm running a truly grassroots campaign. And that means that I'm counting on small-dollar donations from people like you.**[ I**f you have anything extra to spare today, could you chip in $6 — about the cost of a bag of mini Twix, my favorite candy — to help me win this race and flip Florida blue? Polling data shows a tied race, but I need your help to pull ahead.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79017116/455170292/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=6&refcode=jtk795-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjhkZDZjNzEtNjhjYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0UD8cn7RSJHm528RbPOBOxnHK6ylbT-k_oE8AYDv0BY=)

This campaign is about a lot of important issues, but at the end of the day, it really does come down to love, as corny as it may sound. I love Florida and I'm fighting for the leadership and the fair policies that our families deserve. I'll lead with love, compassion, and a listening ear in Washington — not the division, extremism, and partisanship that have defined Rick Scott's time in office. Thank you for being a part of this campaign, believing in leadership guided by love, and fighting for the state I love so much. I am so appreciative of all that you do. With gratitude, and of course, love, Debbie P.S. Unlike Rick Scott, I'm running a truly grassroots campaign. And that means that I'm counting on small-dollar donations from people like you.= | | = | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

Hi team, It’s Valentine's Day, which means I get to tell one of my favorite stories about Callie. The year is 2004 (exactly 20 years ago today) – the spot is her parents' kitchen. **We were in the middle of making chocolate chip cookies when I proposed to Callie.** The way she tells it, she had a mouthful of raw cookie dough when I got down on one knee. But what I remember most about that day – more than the ring I hoped was good enough or the surprised look on her face — was how _certain_ I was that I wanted to spend the rest of my life with Callie. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79017331/455170949/-1638464637?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20240214_fr_vday_spouse_sm_act_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWEzYzgwM2UtNjljYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Eh_xThL2wPQSa-xRgiV7gDjHk4-_ZFEUfo_WZLhwVDs=)

_Pictured: Our wedding day, 9 months later_
Looking back at it now, it's hard to process that 20 years have gone by since she said yes. Callie is still the energetic, tenacious, gritty girl on the track team I proposed to two decades ago. **I knew then — as I know now — that Callie's got my back 100%, and she never gives up fighting for what she believes in.**
So today and every day, she's my Valentine.

Friend, When Congress passed the largest Pentagon budget in history late last year ($886 BILLION) to fund bombs, weapons, and war crimes, roughly half of that money was allocated directly to military contractors. Just this week, the Senate voted on a $95 billion package for war, including $14 billion to Israel’s military as it commits genocide. Between 2019 and 2021, 97 members of Congress or their family members invested in weapons contractor stocks, and 25 of them sat on committees directly responsible for shaping national security policy while they traded and profited off those stocks. Just last year, U.S. lawmakers made 96 transactions in weapons stock, including 8 since October 7. body:
When folks vote for a candidate, they’re making a choice.
#

When folks vote for a candidate, they’re making a choice.
They’re deciding who they think is going to improve their lives. They’re hoping that things can get better, and they’re voting for the person they think can make it happen.
And when folks donate to a candidate, they’re making a similar choice.
They’re making an investment in the future — their $5, $10, whatever they give. They’re hoping that the money they put into a campaign will help get things done.
And over the last several years, we’ve gotten a lot done.
We’ve made historic investments in our infrastructure, in fighting climate change. We’ve taken steps to protect our elections, and we got our economy back on track. Ruben Gallego played a big part in all of that.
If Ruben wins, we keep working.
If Kari Lake and Donald Trump win in Arizona, all that progress falls apart.
That’s the difference, and that’s the choice voters have to make this year. So today, we’re asking you to make a bet that things can keep getting better.
[**We’re asking you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign so we can take another step forward. While today is supposed to be a day to celebrate love, for the community of Parkland, Florida, it is also a day of grieving. Six years ago, a gunman killed 14 students and 3 teachers at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School.

In the years since, we have witnessed many more horrific mass shootings across the country – including in our backyard at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh, where 11 innocent lives were taken just months after Parkland.

Our fight against gun violence is far from over today. Every 12 minutes, someone in the United States is shot and killed. In the first six weeks of 2024 alone, the United States saw 44 mass shootings.

Our leaders should be concerned with keeping families safe rather than bending to the gun lobby’s will.

Once I’m in Congress, I will work for common sense solutions – supported by most Americans – to stop the killing of innocents. Click here for more on my positions and Scott Perry’s terrible record on these issues.

We can begin by restoring the ban on assault weapons. Like many veterans, I have fired these weapons of war. I know their devastating power. And I know, as most of us know, that they belong only in the hands of our trained military professionals defending our freedoms on the battlefield. Period. Full stop.

[I need you to stand with me in demanding gun safety. | Happy Valentine’s Day, Peter!

I feel so lucky to be surrounded by so much love between my children, my friends, and my constituents. Today, I’m also celebrating my love for Pennsylvania, and specifically, the Lehigh Valley.

Growing up in a military family, I never lived in one place for very long. When I moved to the Lehigh Valley more than 30 years ago, I fell in love with the community, and I knew this was where I wanted to stay and raise a family.

My two children, Clay and Adrienne, were born here and attended our public schools. I built my career here and became actively engaged in the community. So when I saw Washington politicians ignoring our voices, I knew I had to take a stand by running for Congress – and it is the honor of a lifetime to be serving my third term representing our district.

I think of my constituents as my extended family, and I care deeply about their struggles, their successes, and their future. My promise to you is that I will never stop advocating for families and workers in Pennsylvania and across the country.

body:
The progressive Congresswoman is facing a multimillion-dollar barrage of advertising, funded by wealthy donors seeking to end her campaign.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37639%2E3422442%2EYqhbGi)
Derek, we have less than three weeks until Election Day and we’re at real risk of losing because **corporate special interests and a handful of wealthy donors want Katie out of Congress for good.**
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240214-2?refcode=em20240214-37639&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37639_3422442_YqhbGi&akid=37639%2E3422442%2EYqhbGi)**

But if we post an impressive number, we can prove we have the momentum and resources we need to win this race, and show these super PACs that they're wasting their money trying to defeat Katie Porter.

We’re thrilled to announce not one, but TWO upcoming Candidate Forums for Republican Candidates! If you are in Montgomery or Garrett County, this is your opportunity to come here and learn more about Mariela! ✔️
Mark your calendars for this February 15th in Montgomery and February 17th in Garrett County. Both of these events are FREE to attend! 🇺🇸🗓️ Save the Dates: 📅 February 15th: Montgomery County -Poolesville Town Hall - 7PM 📅 February 17th: Garrett County -Performing Arts Center/Garrett College 1PM

# FUNDRAISING UPDATE 📈
Our fundraising efforts continue to make headway, all THANKS TO SUPPORTS LIKE YOU!! We are almost at our next major milestone of fundraising a total of $200,000!!!! That is huge for our district, as we have not had a Republican Representative in Congress in over 10 years. Republicans in our district are not conditioned and used to supporting Republican Candidates.
We still have a long way to go, and your contribution can make a significant impact. Every donation means less time on the phone for me and more time connecting with voters, understanding their needs, and advocating for our community. Your support drives our campaign forward, inching us closer to our shared goals. Donate today to help get us through the finish line in the May 14th primary! 🇺🇸🇺🇸

clean_body: Today I’ll be finding some time to celebrate with my wife Elizabeth. | | Peter, happy Valentine’s Day! 💙 I know it can be hard to find joy — we’re constantly bombarded by stories of extreme weather events, gun violence, attacks on our nation’s democracy, and discrimination of all sorts. I entered public service because I care about these issues and the people they impact. But it can feel overwhelming at times. That’s why even in times of darkness, I always try to find moments of joy. Today I’ll be finding some time to celebrate Valentine's Day with my wife Elizabeth. She has been my rock and my refuge every day since embarking on this wild journey to Congress. And even after knowing and loving her for more than two decades, she still brings a smile to my face every time I’m with her. = = = Thank you as always for your support. I hope you can take time today to be surrounded by your loved ones and find some joy! Dan & Valerie

[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_as&n=5)
Dear Peter,
The crisis at the border has reached unimaginable proportions, with devastating consequences for our nation.
The body bags keep piling up. Drugs and human trafficking run rampant. Our cities and towns are overrun and strained to the max. The number of illegal migrants in the United States has roughly _DOUBLED_ under President Biden.
Last night, Biden's own Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas was impeached by the House of Representatives for his failure to enforce border laws. This unprecedented move underscores the urgency and severity of the situation we face.
Our country is on the brink of being lost, and we cannot afford to remain silent any longer.
[That’s why I’m asking you to sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border now. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_as&n=6)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_as&n=7)
Under his watch, the number of people taken into custody by the U.S. Border Patrol has reached an average of 2 million per year — the highest levels in the agency’s 100-year history.
President Biden continues to play chicken with our lives and refuses to use executive authority to secure the border. _In fact, he walked back many of the restrictions that were keeping the crisis under control._
_This is a deliberate political move._
President Biden has held office for 50 years — he’s playing dumb when he pretends he doesn’t know what to do. He’s playing politics when he ties border security to overseas war funding.
It’s egregious that in the United States __we have illegal migrants sleeping in hotels while veterans sleep on the street__.
Enough is enough.
[Sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border.](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_as&n=8)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79022656/455189309/-526893327?refcode=20240214&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjViNzg5Zi03M2NiLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J1oKbSL9T8ptKmpNSfA5ObV3yObXtbEREfk91JH5R80=)

| | | [ ](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hvRoDO52yrVFbnjTA9izxA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnr7VCP0RraHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9jaHJpc3RpYW4tbGVnYWwtc29jaWV0eS9kMGZmMzI4ZC1lZWEyLTQ5MDAtYTE3MC0wNDViMjhiYjk5OTI_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONDY0OTJXA3NwY0IKZcNxHM1lu1JvAlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)

Dear Friend, This is one of the most serious, and most disturbing, threats to Christians in public life ... _yet most Christians in America don't know anything about it!_ **The last, and strongest, line of legal defense for Christians in the United States may soon be destroyed by ideological activists, with a regulatory change being considered in ALL 50 states.** That could make critical legal victories for Americans of faith—like protection of **personal prayer** without getting fired, protection of **moral conscience** so you can’t be forced to dispense abortion-inducing drugs, and even protection of students forming a **Christian student club** —IMPOSSIBLE to pursue... ...and leave Christians and Americans of faith alongside religious ministries, nonprofits, and schools without ANY legal defense when they wrongly, and unconstitutionally, face threats or punishment for their biblical values! **Dear Friend, Christian Legal Society, a fellowship, ministry, and legal defense organization since 1961, is leading the fight to protect Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, state by state.** **[**Against a well-organized, well-funded opposition, we're counting on the support of generous Americans of faith like you to stand with us. Would you consider a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or even $500 to help support Christian Legal Society in this critical work?**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/hvRoDO52yrVFbnjTA9izxA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnr7VCP0RraHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9jaHJpc3RpYW4tbGVnYWwtc29jaWV0eS9kMGZmMzI4ZC1lZWEyLTQ5MDAtYTE3MC0wNDViMjhiYjk5OTI_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Uk9ONDY0OTJXA3NwY0IKZcNxHM1lu1JvAlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

---
For those who don't work in law offices, the rule change I'm discussing may sound boring or unremarkable: it's known as Model Rule 8.4(g) from the American Bar Association. **But its impact has _devastating_ real-world consequences for Christian attorneys and all Americans of faith, as the silencing and punishment of Christian attorneys**—**and the faithful Americans they would otherwise defend** —**seems to be the _sole goal_ of this rule change.** Without any examples of why it's needed ... without any response to the 400+ comments and letters of concern submitted by all attorneys concerned with free speech, the American Bar Association offered no response to rightful concerns that **radical activists could use this to** :
* **discourage or punish attorneys** from sharing political, social, or religious viewpoints that are outside the current political orthodoxy (today, that's typically defined as “progressive” or “Woke”);

* **stop attorneys from volunteering at their churches** , sitting on church boards, or serving schools they’ve gone to, if those schools are Christian or otherwise religious;

* **prevent attorneys from serving in Christian ministries** , no matter how much good work those ministries do in their communities; and

* **put an end to Christian attorneys doing _pro bono_ work to defend religious freedom **on behalf of Christian ministries, nonprofits, or schools that proudly proclaim their commitment to biblical values!

**Dear Friend, there is still time to stop this rule from taking root in America ... but it requires a 50-state strategy and a major investment of time, talent, and legal work.** Christian Legal Society has led the charge on this important issue since it was first raised in 2015. Derek, Donald
Trump just attacked me directly and accused California of voter fraud in
our U.S. Senate race.

With Californians voting right now, there is NO WAY we can allow Trump’s
election disinformation to influence the outcome of this election in the
final days of this primary.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240214_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5492%2E5257348%2EDZb-fo ]I’ll share what he posted to his social media platform in a moment, but
first, can you rush any amount to my campaign to help us respond to this
unhinged Trump attack? We CANNOT allow this claim to go unanswered. Not
today, Derek.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240214_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5492%2E5257348%2EDZb-fo ]DONATE

After calling me a “slimeball,” “low life,” “shifty,” and more, he then
tried to cast doubt on California’s primary election if I win, in an ALL
CAPS social media rant.

With none more damaging than this: “SADLY, BETWEEN RANK ‘NO CHOICE’
VOTING, AND ‘UNLIMITED’ NUMBERS OF MAIL-IN BALLOTS POURING INTO PLACES
UNKNOWN, TO PEOPLE THAT SOMETIMES RECEIVE MANY BALLOTS TO FILL OUT AND
SEND BACK AT WILL, CALIFORNIANS ARE ‘SCREWED!’”

Here are the facts: California’s mail-in ballots are not “unlimited” —
they are limited to one for every registered California voter. Every
ballot has a known destination — its assigned voter’s address on their
voter registration. Every registered voter can only vote once (but on
every ballot this year, the California U.S. Senate seat appears TWICE).
Every ballot must be postmarked by Election Day. And Trump is just spewing
lies about there being ranked-choice voting.

But Derek, Trump’s allies in the far-right media aren’t going to
share the facts.

They’re going to share his words across the right-wing ecosystem. His MAGA
followers will spread his lies far and wide, reaching huge swathes of
California’s 22 million registered voters. Their online obscenities and
attacks against me, as well as written and verbal threats to our offices,
will increase exponentially.

And like the disinformation he sowed that led to the Capitol insurrection,
Trump will attempt to create a new reality for millions of California
voters — and if I win, paint my election as illegitimate.

me personally and undermining confidence in election integrity. It’s clear
there is no candidate he fears more from being elected than me, and for
good reason. Chip in

Friend, yesterday, the House successfully voted to impeach Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas. Good. I’m glad. Requires each local school board to develop and implement a policy to require the annual notification of the parent of each student enrolled in the local school division, to be sent by email and, if applicable, SMS text message within 30 calendar days succeeding the first day of each school year, of the parent's legal responsibility to safely store any firearm present in the household, risks associated with improperly stored firearms, statistics relating to firearm-related accidents, injuries, and death among youth, and other tips and strategies. The bill requires each school board to make such parental notification available in multiple languages on its website. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-79.3](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fEllfj03xBm0s0Y2QN1V5WTMY_ACc88AaE3z5Fed71EDf8UE4y9yv8E2IY20OJ2_4NZWLNgblvKhNSi8NTo63LdoI9Imwlqherc7caGW7jmGVFbin4RBY5_wDJ1Q86bUte8eHus75xZFXCVrYrDXXLoRXy1yE2X5Lb44LTNtV8E=&c=nGJiHaQcrcNYEkcCNUuK9KlSch60aYwc01uS6rTYVrihloGN1Kg2Vw==&ch=ScLCqBY9YfLCRxbJD_8IGjin9-WvGwCqV5up8rPQNNzejarNYvm65w==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to school board policies; parental notification; safe storage of firearms in the household.24104999D

Directs the Board of Medicine to require unconscious bias and cultural competency training as part of the continuing education requirements for renewal of licensure. The bill specifies requirements for the training and requires the Board of Medicine to report on the training to the Department of Health and the Virginia Neonatal Perinatal Collaborative. A BILL to direct the Board of Medicine to require certain licensees to complete training on unconscious bias and cultural competency as part of their continuing education and continuing competency requirements for licensure.24106251D

Current law requires such teachers and personnel to complete mental health awareness training but does not contain any requirements relating to the specific topics such training must address. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-298.6](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fEllfj03xBm0s0Y2QN1V5WTMY_ACc88AaE3z5Fed71EDf8UE4y9yv8E2IY20OJ2_YTwmJcnt5d8ym2f8g7IYcQR7RpokzUZq25d6dXy2482-J1G9GZhE_7_6Y-2Vh_TCznedGu0umvQJY3AaWIX4E4qY16lY8lidzBHE9wWZxF1ZvpaQQkKn4A==&c=nGJiHaQcrcNYEkcCNUuK9KlSch60aYwc01uS6rTYVrihloGN1Kg2Vw==&ch=ScLCqBY9YfLCRxbJD_8IGjin9-WvGwCqV5up8rPQNNzejarNYvm65w==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; mental health awareness training and instruction; requirements.24105961D

Requires health instruction provided to elementary and secondary school students to include certain topics relating to mental health that are enumerated in the bill, including (i) general themes of social and emotional learning, including self-awareness, self-management, responsible decision making, relationship skills, and social awareness; (ii) signs and symptoms of common mental health challenges; and (iii) mental health wellness and healthy strategies for coping with stress and negative feelings, including conflict resolution skills. body:
It’s all Biden’s fault

| **_Unrecognizable._**

That’s all I can say about the state of our country. Over the past few years, it’s been truly disappointing to go to places like New York City, Los Angeles, or Washington D.C. and see the cities overrun with crime, homelessness, and blocks of vacant storefronts and office buildings.

This was **Biden’s Build Back Better Plan,** except he didn’t build anything back better. Instead, DC faced nearly fifty carjackings in the first four days of this year. Los Angeles has never seen higher homelessness numbers, with the numbers surging daily. Six years ago, I was dropping my oldest daughter off at kindergarten when I saw an armed police officer patrolling the drop off-line. It was just days after the tragic shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida where 17 students’ and staff members’ lives were stolen in a horrific mass shooting.

Then, I saw my oldest baby get out of the car with her bright pink unicorn backpack on and walk into her elementary school none the wiser...She had no idea how profoundly the adults in this country had failed her, to the point that she might not be safe in her classroom.

I, on the other hand, became overwhelmed with emotion. In that moment, I felt scared, frustrated, and angry. I felt momentarily hopeless, but then was compelled to act.

I became a vocal advocate, a gun violence prevention researcher, and I ran for Congress — and when I wasn’t able to overcome gerrymandering and the extreme MAGA stronghold in our state — I started the _first and only PAC for kids._

**_[So today, I’m asking for your support: We’re on a mission to elect a Kids First Congress in 2024 and we need to raise $10,400 by the end of the week to get it done. Can you chip in $10 to help?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z3011QGjayrd2kzpmP2c9jFmgc4o5AoO4mOxE6fIOhgMos8lurcnyRJ0C5FAx0SeCs9ziC354YvDLv_ifTkHAnQnYPv_Ygek1teKq8DDDob2XgzLQcilPWFEr6cdkj7GxFkw7Aq7zvR5YLyVoTcLkoa5azANhzxcVKssy9Ps7PuJ-kgaFVdV2UmPh4DwpTWGaryh8XNvqUh2rqPztXZZbj6pcoi8GMMKKE0JOh8IdlW7SzKJZqIFFhMImoCpHvyn-X8P69VMQAT8S1VlPXdZE5a7lhLUx0oE9PS2m2IOvmkN0glh1cTZJ6HxwzWWo7GYL72vPxRGZtVSsyEm-FlYx9yLilJUKld4SMN03HtApwyxkSxvLdRrCQ_Cqr9rtdztBioP3B_0RDZp7ff4ZJJ1AAgLrRoByriyt6-2LfQMQLi4o43HVS1EtCWg9EjZLfqf8/43u/XdICsOr-QqK01mHOSV9c9A/h2/kCTfW3uu_nd4PwVo9_jNFRtU4DzIZrssBvfOFRSgCKA)_**

Listen, when this terrible tragedy happened six years ago, I was engaged in politics enough to be a registered voter and to have the numbers of my Senators and Representative in my phone. But my advocacy didn’t extend beyond leaving voicemails in their offices.

As a pediatrician and a mother, I could not stay silent. Imagine caring for a 3 year old, beautiful little girl, whose face is permanently disfigured due to an unintentional gunshot wound that could have been prevented with a secure storage law. Or a 17 year old boy who is now paralyzed from his second gunshot wound that could have been prevented with federal funding for hospital-based violence intervention programs that address the root causes of community gun violence.

I believe we have a moral imperative to act and I am done waiting for our elected officials to do the right thing. The solutions are not extreme or controversial - they are common sense. And they are supported by a vast majority of Americans.

**_There are no more excuses._**

So if our elected officials refuse to act to protect our children, our only recourse is to replace them with leaders who will. That’s what Their Future PAC is all about.

Today I will continue to honor the lives stolen six years ago at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School with my action. **_[Please join me in building a safer future for our children.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z3011QGjayrd2kzpmP2c9jFmgc4o5AoO4mOxE6fIOhgMos8lurcnyRJ0C5FAx0SeCs9ziC354YvDLv_ifTkHAnQnYPv_Ygek1teKq8DDDob2XgzLQcilPWFEr6cdkj7GxFkw7Aq7zvR5YLyVoTcLkokHJ8Jg4jdBy2g8z55WgpdjYDScIb9WrlNh1DdlKMhBeTlxzjLpd5vfYtJsfAy6Vvuh3pAjfRHjRRBNVPVWzn_FBHNg06u0f4wJDcCVd4qNBWSkbvWDXDGMbPzQdqZ8O0s2O0jYnlJNFo3f7zeNWT5989HH8C3PAOnhrM97uSgCVQMa-knumwQlWUQgaoCAw4u4XyNjtImP2-nj2Y-6iNjoCOO-n_9Zq9h5ehgqe1qAIL7SiXFLZWWjmG7SDfM__KrAOUr_RQqEdGS3YG8AIGUsCtD9_OQFJATiJjHQh7Emg/43u/XdICsOr-QqK01mHOSV9c9A/h4/cFIOOyF6noj_nx9e86KYLgqYmAHrPJOEJeHjMch0xiw)_**

Until the kids are alright,

— Annie

subject: My heart-shaped pans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1923%2E4032634%2E_x5RND)
---
My mother was born on February 14, and she loved her special connection to Valentine’s Day. From the time they were teenage sweethearts, my daddy bought my mother a heart-shaped box of chocolates every year. I still have a box of valentines that he gave her all those years ago. I loved celebrating my mother's birthday and Valentine's Day as a double-feature. When I was a little girl, I bought some heart-shaped pans at the dime store. It became a family tradition: Every year, I baked my mother a heart-shaped cake. Decades later, when she was in her 80s, she had some minor surgery — nothing serious. The day before she was scheduled to go home, she was in good cheer. All the kids and grandkids came to visit, and we gathered in her hospital room to tell funny stories. We laughed and had juice and cookies. Finally, Daddy sent us all home, and we left that evening expecting her to be released from the hospital the next day. Then, in the middle of the night, my brother called. He said that our mother was dead. Daddy had been sitting with her when she leaned forward and said, "Don, there's that gas pain again." Then she died. I was almost too shocked to cry. I just couldn't believe it. How could this have happened? The autopsy showed that she had advanced heart disease — never diagnosed and never treated. Despite her regular trips to the doctor for check-ups and repeated trips for "that gas pain," she had never been checked for heart trouble. No one had any idea. Later, I would learn that heart disease is the #1 killer of women. It was considered a “man’s disease,” but doctors do a much better job screening and treating women for it now than when my mother had her heart attack. Even though my mother is gone now, I still have my heart-shaped pans. This week, I baked a heart-shaped cake, and opened up the box filled with old valentines from my daddy. It’s how I remember her. | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1891?t=8&akid=1923%2E4032634%2E_x5RND)
---

And I’m also doing something more: I’m fighting — with every bone in my body — to make sure everyone can get the health care they need to live long, healthy lives with the people they love. So you know I’m staying in the fight to protect Medicare and the Affordable Care Act, no matter how hard Republican extremists attack them. Health care is a basic human right. And we fight for basic human rights.
I also want to make a pitch for one more program: Medicaid. Millions of Americans with a history of heart disease, stroke, or other cardiovascular diseases rely on Medicaid as their safety net. Look, we don’t know whose baby is going to be born with a hole in her heart and run up $1 million in medical bills in the first few months. We don’t know whose grandma is going to have a massive stroke and need to go into a nursing home. But what we do know is that as Americans, we all pitch in some nickels so that if it happens to your family, the rest of us will all be there. I’m in this fight for Medicaid all the way.
I’m grateful you’re on this team.
Happy Valentine’s Day to you and everyone you love,
Elizabeth

subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12679979?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My fellow Floridians,

I had an exciting and productive week in Tallahassee! Last week, I had the opportunity to meet with stakeholders and constituents, as well as participate in Marion County Days at the Florida Capitol. It is the honor of a lifetime to serve and represent my community! I am working hard alongside my legislative colleagues to make District 24 a better place for the next generation of Floridians.

Thank you for reading this weekly recap of some of the great things happening in our Capital City. We are making great progress for our state! I truly appreciate your continued trust and support.
---
|
---
| | | | | | [](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0508b47403&e=d1c1b9864f) | [Follow Rep. Chamberlin on Facebook](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cbba1de895&e=d1c1b9864f)
---|---
| | **Around the Capitol**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of meeting with representatives from Florida Justice Reform to discuss their legislative priorities for this session. It was great to learn more about how this organization is combating wasteful civil litigation in our state.
---
|
---
| It was an honor to welcome several health center CEOs from Marion County to the Florida Capitol to talk about legislation and ongoing projects in Marion County. High-quality and reliable healthcare is important to me, and I promise to work diligently to ensure patients and healthcare professionals have what they need to thrive.
---
|
---
| On Tourism Day at the Capitol, I had the pleasure of meeting with the Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association and fellow members from the Marion County community. It was great to talk about legislative priorities and the importance of the hospitality and tourism industries in Florida’s economy.
---
|
---
| My legislative aide, Ben, had the honor of welcoming several Assisted Living Facility presidents and industry partners from around the state to my office to talk about legislative priorities and my bill, [HB 995 - Civil Actions Involving Assisted Living Facilities](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=87e2ab9848&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
| | **Marion County Days at the Florida Capitol**
---
|
---
| It was a privilege to meet with Diane Schofield, the founder of Hands of Mercy Everywhere in Belleview. We discussed legislative priorities and important appropriations projects. I am honored to support this incredible organization that comes alongside young girls in our community who need help and support.
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of welcoming Marion County Commissioners and other community leaders to Tallahassee to discuss legislative priorities, as well as ongoing projects happening in Marion County. It is an honor to work alongside these great public servants to make our county a better place for Florida families.
---
|
---
| It was wonderful to meet with AdventHealth CEO Erika Skula to discuss legislative priorities and receive an update on their projects in Ocala. This great faith-based healthcare organization is doing such good work in our community, and it is a pleasure to support their needs in the Florida House.
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| I had the honor of attending and speaking at Marion County Days at the Florida Capitol. The Capitol Courtyard was lined with several informational tents hosted by Marion County businesses and nonprofits. There was also a constant line at Big Lee’s food truck! I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to all those who took the time out of their busy schedules to celebrate Marion County in Tallahassee. It was great to see such a strong turnout!
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to sit down with Mayor Marshall Roddy of McIntosh, Councilman Frank Ciotti, and Town Manager Jessica Gonzalez to discuss appropriation projects and legislative priorities. It was a pleasure to meet with them and learn more about the issues important to their community.
---
|
---
| It was a privilege to meet with Cox Communication to talk about their legislative priorities this session and what I can do to serve them in the Florida Legislature. I greatly appreciate what they do for our state and communities.
---
|
---
| Marion County School Board member Allison Campbell stopped by to drop off some cards that some students wrote to me. I am very grateful to Allison for making the effort to bring them by my office. The kind words from District 24’s students made my day!
---
|
---
| I enjoyed meeting with several Cambridge students in my office. These bright young people were excited to share their legislative ideas and be part of the legislative process. It was a pleasure to welcome them to Tallahassee!
---
| | **Week 5 Committee Meetings**
---
| Last week, I joined my colleagues in several committee meetings to discuss important legislation for our state. We are making great progress!

**Week 5 Committee Meetings:**
* Select Committee on Health Innovation
* Regulatory Reform and Economic Development Subcommittee
* State Administration and Technology Appropriation Subcommittee
* Judiciary Committee

---
|
---
| | I am working hard for you and your family in Tallahassee! Thank you for electing me to serve you. It is the highest honor to represent you in the Florida Legislature.

I look forward to keeping you updated on my work during the 2024 Legislative Session. As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0dd896a50b&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---
| | | | | | [](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=86d0ce3ec9&e=d1c1b9864f) | [Follow Rep. Chamberlin on Facebook](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c841c7fab7&e=d1c1b9864f)
---|---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

**Our mailing address is:**
1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

You can [update your preferences](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=457af7d291) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=457af7d291).
