name: Rachel Feldman, Giffords.org
subject: My hometown of Parkland, FL was changed forever six years ago today
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
My name is Rachel Feldman, and I’m part of the fundraising team here at GIFFORDS. Six years ago today, a mass shooter stole the lives of seventeen people and injured seventeen more in a school shooting in my hometown of Parkland, Florida.
My sister was a senior at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School at the time and had to hide in a supply closet with 25 other students for six hours. At one point her phone died, and my family and I didn’t know if we would hear from her again.
My sister is luckily a survivor, but our family and community will never be quite the same as we were before February 14, 2018. That day, we became one of the many communities in our nation that have been changed forever by the trauma of gun violence. Since then, countless others have followed.
I joined the GIFFORDS team just a few months ago because I couldn’t think of a more meaningful mission to dedicate myself to than the gun safety movement. This feels like more than just a job, since it’s so personal to my family and my community. I’m proud to represent them every day as I share my story.
[**As we remember six years since the shooting in Parkland, I’m asking if you’ll make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today. Your support goes directly towards our work to create a future free from gun violence—a future where we no longer have tragedies like the one in Parkland.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb24.CYoP11&refcode=em240214-2-30&t=1&akid=7643%2E3935704%2EOJ9Uxf)
**[CONTRIBUTE TODAY](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-feb24.CYoP11&refcode=em240214-2-30&t=2&akid=7643%2E3935704%2EOJ9Uxf)**
Thank you for taking the time to read my family’s story as we mark six years since the Parkland shooting. Please know that your support of GIFFORDS—especially today—makes a huge impact on our ability to save lives from preventable violence.
Sincerely,
Rachel Feldman
GIFFORDS Mid-Atlantic Development Manager

Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

| Peter,

Happy Valentine’s Day! Today is a day to remind those around you, family and friends and neighbors, how much you love and appreciate them.

**One thing I’m also thinking about today is my love for Virginia.** Virginia is where my family settled when I was a kid, after multiple moves with my father’s job. Virginia is the place that nurtured my love of history and our country - in my public school classrooms, as an undergraduate at UVA, or in visits across the rich history of Virginia and our country. Virginia’s always been home as I traveled and worked abroad — not just my home leave location — but the place where my family and Adam’s family have always been ready and waiting to welcome us. Virginia is also the place where Adam and I chose to raise our children, moving home ten years ago, just miles from where we grew up.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79027835/455205743/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-02-14_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDI2OWJmODUtN2ZjYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bFeR75zjBlb5wKtoZJJXYcXztqCGe7P2FUieRkacq40=)
_These photos are from when we came home to visit in December 2011. It was my daughter Charlotte’s visit home to Virginia and the United States! This is our family - my parents and Adam’s parents and my two sisters and Adam’s two brothers and their families meeting us at the Richmond airport!_
My love for Virginia and its people is what drove me to first run for Congress in 2018. I’ve proudly served Virginia’s Seventh District through extraordinary moments in history, and I have worked every day to lower prescription drug costs, rebuild our infrastructure, support our veterans, and defend our rights.

Our Commonwealth has so much to offer, but right now, we’re seeing dangerous and divisive rhetoric take over Richmond and drive extreme policies — like book bans and abortion bans. I can’t sit idly by and watch extreme voices try to dismantle our democracy and our Commonwealth.

That’s why I’m running for Governor – I’ll bring a deep love for our Commonwealth, an unwavering dedication to hard work, and a commitment to uniting people to tackle the genuine issues confronting Virginians.

[_**I know this race won’t be easy, but I’m no stranger to a competitive race — and I know that with the strength of our grassroots support, we can accomplish anything. body:
The hottest gift this Valentines Day is a contribution to their favorite candidate -- and other news.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/94e5314d2ef2/be-my-valentine?e=3d27610f3d)

** Hey Peter. Will you be my Valentine?
------------------------------------------------------------
Today is Valentine's Day, a day set aside to reflect on and appreciate those things that we hold dear to our hearts; the people, places, and memories that we love. I hope that you are able to spend today with people you cherish.

Remember, the best way to say I love you is to make a donation to your favorite candidate.

Click below give the most appreciated -- and tax deductible -- gift of love this Valentine's Day!
Click to Contribute (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=9528662311-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_13_03_35&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9528662311-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Joking aside, today also marks the beginning of Lent, a 40 day season dedicated to self-reflection and improvement that is usually celebrated by giving up something, whether hobby or habit, that you love for those 40 days.

It is an interesting combination, and it has given me pause as I think about the things I love and what among those things I would be willing to let go. At the end of the day, I think my answers are the same as yours. At least, I hope so.

I love my wife. Without her there would be no me.

I love my daughters. Without them I would not worry about our future.

I love my country. Without it I would not have the opportunity to reach my full potential or the chance to help others reach theirs.

Obviously, there are so many more things on the list: puppies, kittens, flowers, birds, the color of the sky after it rains, or the sight of the sun dipping into the ocean. Love is easy.

The hard part is giving something up. What on that list can I do away with for a meager 40 days, much less a lifetime?

Oddly enough, I am giving up something that is not on the list of love, but is still a part of me -- I am giving up on hatred.

I hate the fact that I consider my neighbors and friends enemies because they disagree with me. I hate the fact that our country has become so hyper-partisan that a football game becomes a political statement. The list of things I hate goes on for at least as long as the things I love, but it starts with I hate the idea that we, as Americans, can't talk to each other.

So, I'm not going to believe it anymore, and I challenge you to do the same. At least for the next 40 days.

body:
https://www.wileynickel.com/ [https://www.wileynickel.com/]
Friends –
Today marks six years since the tragic shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. On that day, 14 students and three staff members lost their lives due to senseless gun violence. Parents lost children, brothers and sisters lost siblings, and a community was shattered.
https://www.wileynickel.com/ [https://www.wileynickel.com/]
My heart still breaks for the friends and family members of the victims. As a parent, there is no greater fear than sending your children to school and having them not come home safely. I can’t imagine what those families have gone through.
Touring the site last November was a powerful and moving experience I'll never forget. I'm glad to have colleagues like Representative Jared Moskowitz and Democratic Whip Katherine Clark to help turn grief and anger into meaningful action. But I’ll be honest, Peter, our country has not made enough progress on this issue since 2018. There hasn’t been comprehensive, common-sense gun reform enacted, and mass shootings are still all too common.
I want my kids to grow up in a safer world, and I will continue advocating for common-sense gun reform. I will support candidates who are committed to ending the gun violence epidemic, and I won’t stop until real progress is made.
Thank you,
Wiley

Team — Six years ago, 17 innocent people were killed in a mass shooting at my alma mater, Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School. This senseless act of gun violence changed our community forever. It takes the will to act, and that is why I led the charge in the Florida State House to pass the Marjory Stoneman Douglas School Safety Act, which put red flag laws in place, raised the age to buy a firearm to 21, and provided hundreds of millions of dollars for school safety and mental health services. In Congress, I have been able to bring legislators to tour MSD and give them a first-hand look at what happens when government fails our kids. The only thing parents did wrong that day was send their kids to school. Families have been devastated by this preventable senseless act, and I will continue to work everyday to ensure this doesn’t happen again. Standing with you, \- Jared

Friend, It’s time we end Measure 110.

Measure 110 decriminalized the possession of hard drugs such as meth, heroin, and fentanyl in Oregon - It’s time to put an end to these leftist Portland policies.

It’s time we re-criminalize hard drug possession offenses.

I’ll be honest with you...

Measure 110 has not achieved its intended outcomes and has contributed to many challenges:

Rising homelessness Fentanyl overdoses Public drug use

clean_body: | | | | \- - | Friend, It’s time we end Measure 110. Measure 110 decriminalized the possession of hard drugs such as meth, heroin, and fentanyl in Oregon - It’s time to put an end to these leftist Portland policies. It’s time we re-criminalize hard drug possession offenses. I’ll be honest with you... Measure 110 has not achieved its intended outcomes and has contributed to many challenges: Rising homelessness Fentanyl overdoses Public drug use | | I know that we need to find ways to combat drug use in Oregon. I’m fighting every day in Congress to find new pathways to end homelessness, overdoses, and public drug use. Thank you, | | Lori Chavez-DeRemer | | | | | A Note For You, From Lori Chavez-DeRemer Thank you for your unwavering support as we strive to build a stronger, safer, and more prosperous future for Oregon. I am committed to prioritizing the safety of our communities, putting America and Oregon first, supporting our veterans, empowering farmers, improving transportation and infrastructure, and addressing homelessness. With your continued support, we can work together to implement effective measures and policies that will positively impact the lives of our residents and the overall well-being of Oregon. Fellow Americans,

Sometimes, it's easy to get lost in hysteria. It's easy to assume that people speak in overstatements.

**But, when a special counsel appointed by his own Department of Justice describes the sitting President as _' An Elderly Man with a Poor Memory,'_ you should know that this is no longer a Left versus Right disagreement.**

[**Our Nation, its safety, and its future are in the hands of someone who cannot even remember when he served as Vice President.**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2da4ad7f8f044b43ace103fb85aef7e8&_e=mG08hgrjghjdmuHWuzDemD3HfTYVQEW1IJwBkcCU3yAas0Z3TNUzt-JmSFjaWxJKot1owcCVP5ge_4Ogv7DI-DlazeT6nDH3iSsmZ5UNkc00sEDtCYuovfHWiHI4cGRSx6u7HbFub2WPNujC8u2XYGlerNR4CX9ns-xBr2IHyS2ZD9Oglfdu6Eh9ch7pKk6zxg2aftMJcrBnFXgqYUBybJV3UzNcvP7dailIREMY7Y5JPMp5jcElO-EsehdcPjVARM3TjZ4wCpEm6N4324ve8dyFkN4NOzGrjcra5fy0sf2yPoczCmuKwN_wFbMdI2a7y_227v4tID-QnwO7XdYpOwOAxte68mv67KuFE9lvYAPr1wxF4gaYAXtfi9Zz5KN8PQ98ZQvfxDHgujTCLNDMqw%3D%3D)

Friend, I know my campaign manager reached out to you yesterday, but I wanted to reach out personally to let you know how important you are to my campaign. And we are quickly approaching a very crucial fundraising deadline. It’s absolutely critical that we meet this goal so that we can continue our fight against the far-left Democrats. This is where you come into play. I know if you are from Florida, California, Texas or New York, it might seem weird to hear from some Michigander. But let me tell you why this is so important: We have the opportunity to flip the Senate this year — but only if Michigan goes red. Chuck Schumer knows that I am the single greatest threat to his fragile majority and is ready to attack me from all angles. I’ve never been one who is afraid to take a punch, but if my time in the military and FBI taught me anything — it’s that you have to hit back harder. Thank you in advance for your support! Sincerely, Mike Rogers Paid for by Rogers for Senate.
